recipes.title: Fluffy Pancakes

ingredients.name: Butter, melted, plus extra for the pan

steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a large bowl.
In a jug, beat the milk, eggs and melted butter together. Pour into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe with a little butter.
Pour in about 3 tablespoons of batter per pancake. Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, flip and cook 1 minute more.
Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with maple syrup or fruit.

recipes.title: Classic French Toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
Dip each slice of bread in the egg mixture for a few seconds per side.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden. Repeat with the remaining bread, adding butter as needed.
Serve hot with maple syrup or fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Cheesy Scrambled Eggs on Toast
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Toast the bread.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over low heat. Add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula.
When the eggs are almost set but still glossy, take off the heat and fold in the cheese.
Spoon onto the toast and scatter with chives.

recipes.title: Vegetable Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt half the butter in a frying pan and cook the pepper, green onions and mushrooms for 4 minutes until soft. Tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the butter, pour in the eggs and swirl. Cook gently, pulling the edges in, until nearly set.
Scatter the vegetables and cheese over one half, fold the omelette over and slide onto a plate. Cut in half to serve two.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats
steps: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt, honey, grated apple and cinnamon in a bowl or four jars.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Stir, loosen with a splash of milk if needed and top with berries.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Porridge
steps: Put the oats, milk and salt in a saucepan. Mash one banana and stir it in.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Stir in the cinnamon and maple syrup.
Slice the second banana and spoon it over the bowls.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
steps: Heat the oil in a large deep frying pan. Cook the onion and pepper for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, season and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make six wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and crumbled feta. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and soften the onion and chili for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and beans, season and simmer for 8 minutes.
Meanwhile fry the eggs in a separate pan and warm the tortillas.
Spoon the bean sauce onto the tortillas, top each with an egg and avocado slices, and scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a frying pan and cook the pepper for 3 minutes.
Add the eggs and scramble gently until just set.
Warm the tortillas. Divide the eggs between them, top with cheese and salsa and roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Egg
steps: Mash the avocados with the lime juice, salt and pepper.
Toast the bread. Poach or fry the eggs to your liking.
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with an egg and sprinkle with chili flakes.

recipes.title: Yogurt Berry Parfait
steps: Layer yogurt, berries and granola in four glasses.
Repeat the layers and finish with a drizzle of honey. Serve straight away so the granola stays crunchy.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble
steps: Pat the tofu dry and crumble it with your fingers.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, turmeric and cumin and cook for 4 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season well and serve with toast.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook the spaghetti in plenty of salted boiling water until al dente. Save a cup of the cooking water.
Meanwhile warm the oil in a large pan over low heat. Add the garlic and chili flakes and cook gently until the garlic is pale gold.
Add the drained spaghetti and a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy.
Stir in the parsley, season and serve with parmesan if you like.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Turn up the heat, add the beef and brown it, breaking it up with a spoon.
Stir in the tomato paste, tomatoes and oregano. Season, cover partly and simmer for 30 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water and drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Penne
steps: Cook the penne in salted boiling water.
Meanwhile soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the cream and season.
Toss with the drained pasta, parmesan and torn basil.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta with Peas
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water. Add the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Drain, keeping a little cooking water.
Toss with the pesto, a splash of the water and most of the parmesan.
Serve topped with the remaining cheese and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni and Cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the macaroni for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer, stirring, until thick. Take off the heat and stir in most of the cheese and the mustard. Season.
Mix the sauce with the macaroni and pour into a baking dish.
Top with the rest of the cheese and the breadcrumbs. Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Pasta Carbonara
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water. Keep a mug of the cooking water.
Fry the bacon (with the garlic, if using) until crisp. Remove the garlic.
Beat the eggs with the parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
Take the pan off the heat, add the drained pasta to the bacon, then pour in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water, tossing quickly so it turns creamy rather than scrambled.
Serve straight away with more pepper and cheese.

recipes.title: One-Pot Vegetable Pasta
steps: Put everything except the basil into a large wide pan.
Bring to the boil, then simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is cooked and most of the liquid is absorbed.
Season, tear in the basil and serve.

recipes.title: Tuna Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the penne for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Soften the onion in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tuna, sweetcorn and drained pasta and season.
Tip into a baking dish, cover with cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Linguine
steps: Cook the linguine in salted boiling water.
Melt the butter in a large pan and cook the garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until pink.
Add the drained pasta, lemon zest and juice, parsley and a splash of pasta water. Toss and serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom Stroganoff Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water.
Melt the butter and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook on high until browned.
Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute, then the stock. Simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream over low heat, season and toss with the pasta. Scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagne
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Cook the onion, zucchini and eggplant in the oil for 10 minutes. Add the garlic and tomatoes, season and simmer for 10 minutes.
Spread a little sauce in a baking dish, then layer pasta sheets, sauce and spoonfuls of ricotta. Repeat, finishing with sauce.
Top with torn mozzarella and parmesan and bake for 40 to 45 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (410°F).
Toss the potatoes, chicken, smashed garlic, oil, thyme, salt and pepper in a roasting tin. Turn the chicken skin side up.
Squeeze over the lemon and tuck the squeezed halves into the tin.
Roast for 40 minutes until the chicken is golden and cooked through and the potatoes are crisp.

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Toss the chicken with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot. Stir-fry the chicken for 4 minutes and remove.
Stir-fry the vegetables for 3 minutes, adding a splash of water if needed. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken with the remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil. Toss for 1 minute and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onions for 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir to coat, then the tomatoes. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and garam masala and simmer 5 minutes more. Season and top with cilantro. Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken
steps: Mix the honey, soy sauce and garlic.
Brown the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes per side.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until sticky and cooked through.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve with rice and greens.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices, half the oil and a pinch of salt.
Cook in a very hot pan for 5 to 6 minutes until cooked, then remove.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the peppers and onion for 5 minutes until charred at the edges.
Return the chicken, squeeze over the lime and serve in warm tortillas with sour cream and avocado.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic.
Pour in the stock, add the thyme and the whole chicken breasts. Simmer for 15 minutes until cooked.
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Add the noodles and cook for 5 minutes. Return the chicken, season and add parsley.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Chicken Tenders
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and line a tray with baking paper.
Beat the eggs. Mix the breadcrumbs, parmesan, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Dip the chicken in egg, then the crumbs. Lay on the tray and drizzle with oil.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.

recipes.title: Chicken and Rice Skillet
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika, then stir in the rice.
Pour in the stock, return the chicken, cover and simmer gently for 18 minutes.
Scatter over the peas, cover again for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and season.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Season the chicken and cook in a little oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side. Rest, then slice.
Fry the bread cubes in the remaining oil until crisp.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, garlic and half the parmesan, loosening with water.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, then top with chicken, croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Skewers
steps: Mix the yogurt, spices, crushed garlic, grated ginger, lemon juice and salt. Stir in the chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or cook in a hot griddle pan for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef with the onion in a dry pan for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, spices and tomato paste with a splash of water. Simmer 5 minutes and season.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese and a spoon of sour cream.

recipes.title: Chili con Carne
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic.
Add the beef and brown well. Stir in the spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste and stock. Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the beans and cook 10 minutes more. Season and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Burgers
steps: Mix the beef, onion, salt and pepper lightly and shape into four patties a little wider than the buns.
Cook in a hot pan or grill for 4 to 5 minutes per side. Add the cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, the burgers and ketchup.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Toss the beef with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes and drain.
Stir-fry the beef in very hot oil for 2 minutes and remove.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the broccoli, beef, the rest of the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar and 4 tablespoons water. Toss until glossy and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with the butter and milk and season.
Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the onion and carrot in the oil for 8 minutes, then brown the lamb.
Stir in the tomato paste, worcestershire sauce and stock. Simmer for 15 minutes and add the peas.
Spoon into a baking dish, top with the mash and rough it up with a fork.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Swedish-Style Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef, onion, breadcrumbs, egg, nutmeg, salt and pepper. Roll into walnut-sized balls.
Brown the meatballs in the butter in batches and set aside.
Stir the flour into the pan for 1 minute, then whisk in the stock, cream and soy sauce.
Return the meatballs and simmer for 10 minutes until cooked and the sauce has thickened. Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak with Potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes for 6 minutes and drain well.
Fry them in the oil until golden and crisp, about 10 minutes. Season and keep warm.
Season the steaks and sear in a very hot pan for 2 to 4 minutes per side.
Add the butter, crushed garlic and rosemary and spoon over the steaks. Rest 5 minutes, then serve with the potatoes.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apples
steps: Season the chops and brown in the oil for 4 minutes per side. Remove.
Add the butter, onion and apples and cook for 6 minutes until golden.
Stir in the stock, mustard and thyme, return the chops and simmer for 5 minutes until cooked through.

recipes.title: Sausage and Bean Casserole
steps: Brown the sausages in the oil and remove.
Cook the onion for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and paprika.
Add the tomatoes, beans and thyme, return the sausages and simmer for 25 minutes. Season and serve with bread or mash.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (300°F). Rub the pork with the paprika, sugar, garlic powder and salt.
Put the onion in a casserole, sit the pork on top and add 150 ml water. Cover and cook for 4 hours until very tender.
Shred the meat with two forks. Mix the ketchup, vinegar and worcestershire sauce with some of the cooking juices and stir through.
Pile into the buns.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon and Dill
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Put the salmon on a lined tray. Mix the oil, crushed garlic, lemon zest and dill and spoon over.
Season and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until just flaking. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, ginger and garlic.
Sear the salmon skin side down in the oil for 4 minutes, then turn.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, spooning it over until glossy.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos
steps: Rub the fish with the spices and salt.
Fry in the oil for 2 to 3 minutes per side until it flakes.
Mix the mayonnaise with the juice of one lime.
Fill warm tortillas with cabbage, flaked fish, lime mayo and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
steps: Melt the butter in a large pan and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and chili and cook for 2 minutes per side until pink.
Add the lemon juice and parsley, season and serve with rice or crusty bread.

recipes.title: Fish Cakes
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash. Poach the fish in simmering water for 5 minutes and flake.
Mix the potato, fish, green onions, parsley, lemon zest, salt and pepper. Shape into eight cakes.
Dip in beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season and finish with lime juice. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Dal
steps: Simmer the lentils with the water and turmeric for 20 minutes until soft, stirring now and then.
Meanwhile fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, cumin and chili for 1 minute, then the tomatoes for 3 minutes.
Stir the onion mixture into the lentils, season and simmer 5 minutes. Top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Heat half the oil in a wok, scramble the eggs and remove.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the carrot for 2 minutes, then the peas, garlic and most of the green onions.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 4 minutes until hot.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil and eggs and toss. Scatter with the remaining green onions.

recipes.title: Black Bean Burgers
steps: Mash the beans roughly. Mix in the breadcrumbs, egg, spices, chopped green onions and salt.
Shape into four patties and chill for 10 minutes if you have time.
Fry in the oil for 5 to 6 minutes per side until crisp.
Serve in buns with tomato and avocado.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Cook the onion in the oil and half the butter for 5 minutes. Add the mushrooms and garlic and cook until browned.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, letting each addition absorb before the next. This takes about 20 minutes.
When the rice is creamy and just tender, stir in the remaining butter and parmesan. Season and rest 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the packet says, drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the hot oil for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the noodles, soy sauce and honey. Toss for 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Quiche
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F). Line a 23 cm tart tin with the pastry and bake blind for 12 minutes.
Soften the onion in the oil, add the spinach until wilted, then squeeze out the excess liquid.
Spread the spinach and crumbled feta over the pastry.
Whisk the eggs, milk, nutmeg, salt and pepper and pour over. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until just set.

recipes.title: Margherita Flatbread Pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Loosen the tomato paste with a little water, oregano and salt and spread over the tortillas.
Top with torn mozzarella and drizzle with oil.
Bake on trays for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp and bubbling. Scatter with basil.

recipes.title: Veggie Chili
steps: Soften the onion, peppers and sweet potato in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and 200 ml water. Simmer for 25 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir in the sweetcorn, heat through and season.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Halve the peppers and remove the seeds.
Mix the rice, beans, sweetcorn, tomatoes, cumin and salt.
Fill the pepper halves, place in a dish and cover with foil. Bake for 25 minutes.
Uncover, top with cheese and bake 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Vegetable Frittata
steps: Heat the grill (broiler). Cook the onion, zucchini and pepper in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 8 minutes. Add the spinach to wilt.
Beat the eggs with salt, pepper and most of the cheese and pour over.
Cook on low for 8 minutes until the base is set.
Scatter over the rest of the cheese and grill for 3 to 4 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Falafel Wraps
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, spices, flour and salt in a food processor until coarse. Or mash very well.
Shape into 16 small patties.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Mix the tahini with lemon juice and water to a drizzling sauce.
Fill the pitas with falafel, cucumber, tomato and the tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Toss the sweet potato with the oil, spices and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Warm the beans with a splash of water and season.
Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt.
Fill warm tortillas with sweet potato, beans, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Brush the eggplant slices with oil, season and roast on trays for 20 minutes.
Simmer the garlic and tomatoes with the oregano for 10 minutes. Season.
Layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and parmesan in a dish, finishing with cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling. Scatter with basil.

recipes.title: Tofu Peanut Stir-Fry
steps: Toss the tofu in the cornstarch and fry in the oil until crisp on all sides. Remove.
Stir-fry the sliced pepper and broccoli for 4 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, maple syrup, lime juice, garlic and 4 tablespoons hot water.
Return the tofu, pour over the sauce and toss. Top with peanuts and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Potato and Pea Curry
steps: Fry the chopped onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes and 250 ml water. Cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the peas for 3 minutes, season and scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Bean and Cheese Quesadillas
steps: Mash the beans with the cumin.
Spread on four tortillas, top with cheese and salsa and cover with the other tortillas.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
steps: Cut all the vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the eggplant and cook 5 minutes, then the zucchini, peppers and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and thyme, cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes.
Season and stir in the basil. Good hot or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Mac and Cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Boil the cauliflower for 5 minutes and drain well.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in most of the cheese and the mustard and season.
Mix with the cauliflower in a dish, top with the remaining cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the basil and blend until smooth. Season and swirl in the cream.

recipes.title: Minestrone
steps: Dice the onion, carrot and celery and cook in the oil for 10 minutes. Add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans and pasta and cook for 10 minutes, adding the shredded kale for the last 3.
Season and serve with grated parmesan.

recipes.title: Creamy Potato Leek Soup
steps: Melt the butter and cook the leeks gently for 8 minutes without browning.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season. Top with chives.

recipes.title: Lentil and Vegetable Soup
steps: Chop the vegetables and cook in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and cumin.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 25 minutes.
Blend half the soup for a creamy texture, season and add lemon juice.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Soup
steps: Cook the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the squash and spices and cook 3 minutes.
Add the stock and simmer for 20 minutes until the squash is soft.
Blend with the coconut milk until smooth and season.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
steps: Melt the butter and cook the onions with the sugar very slowly for 40 minutes, stirring, until deep golden.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes. Season.
Toast the bread, top with cheese and grill until bubbling.
Ladle the soup into bowls and float the cheese toasts on top.

recipes.title: Black Bean Soup
steps: Cook the chopped onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and cumin.
Add the beans and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend about half, season and add lime juice. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Miso Noodle Soup
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer with the mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook as the packet says.
Add the tofu and spinach for 1 minute. Take off the heat and stir in the miso and soy sauce.
Ladle into bowls and top with sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
steps: Cut the tomatoes, cucumber and pepper into chunks and thinly slice the onion.
Toss with the olives, oil, vinegar, oregano and a little salt.
Top with the feta in a slab or crumbled.

recipes.title: Quinoa Salad with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F). Chop the vegetables, toss with 1 tablespoon oil and roast for 25 minutes.
Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 400 ml water for 15 minutes. Drain and cool slightly.
Mix the quinoa with the vegetables, the rest of the oil, lemon juice, parsley, salt and pepper. Crumble over the feta.

recipes.title: Chickpea Salad
steps: Dice the cucumber and onion and halve the tomatoes.
Toss everything with the oil, lemon juice, cumin and salt. Rest 10 minutes for the flavors to mingle.

recipes.title: Asian Cabbage Slaw
steps: Whisk the vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and honey.
Toss with the cabbage, carrot, sliced green onions and cilantro.
Scatter with chopped peanuts.

recipes.title: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella.
Arrange alternately on a plate with basil leaves.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic and season well.

recipes.title: Tuna Nicoise Salad
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 4. Drain and cool.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and halve.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, olives, tuna and eggs on a platter and drizzle with dressing.

recipes.title: Cucumber Yogurt Salad
steps: Grate or finely dice the cucumber and squeeze out excess water.
Mix with the yogurt, crushed garlic, chopped mint, cumin and salt. Chill until needed.

recipes.title: Warm Potato Salad
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and halve.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Toss the warm potatoes with the dressing, onion and chives.

recipes.title: Garlic Roasted Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the potatoes with the oil, smashed garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.

recipes.title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
steps: Peel and chop the potatoes and boil in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until very tender.
Drain well and let steam for 2 minutes.
Mash with the butter and warm milk until smooth. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Roasted Broccoli with Lemon
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
Toss the broccoli with the oil, sliced garlic and salt and roast for 18 to 20 minutes until charred at the edges.
Squeeze over lemon and grate over parmesan.

recipes.title: Honey Glazed Carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Halve the carrots lengthwise.
Toss with melted butter, honey, thyme and salt and roast for 25 minutes until tender and glazed.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Put everything in a saucepan, bring to the boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat for 15 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Garlic Green Beans
steps: Boil the beans for 3 minutes and drain.
Heat the oil, add the garlic for 30 seconds, then toss in the beans for 2 minutes. Season and scatter with toasted almonds.

recipes.title: Spanish Tomato Rice
steps: Cook the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, paprika and rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer gently for 18 minutes until the liquid is absorbed. Season.

recipes.title: Garlic Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix the butter, garlic, parsley and a pinch of salt.
Slice the baguette without cutting all the way through and spread the butter between the slices.
Wrap in foil and bake for 10 minutes, then open the foil for 2 minutes to crisp.

recipes.title: Classic Hummus
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt with 3 tablespoons cold water until very smooth.
With the motor running, add 2 tablespoons oil.
Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with the remaining oil and dust with paprika.

recipes.title: Guacamole
steps: Mash the avocados with the lime juice and salt, leaving some texture.
Stir in the onion, tomato, chopped chili and cilantro. Taste and adjust.

recipes.title: Bruschetta
steps: Mix the tomatoes with 2 tablespoons oil, torn basil and salt.
Slice and toast the baguette. Rub each slice with the cut garlic clove and drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Spoon the tomatoes on top and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Make sandwiches with the cheese inside and the buttered sides out.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and melted.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Halve and scoop the yolks into a bowl. Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard and salt.
Spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika and chives.

recipes.title: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Pat the chickpeas very dry.
Toss with the oil, spices and salt and spread on a tray.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy. They crisp more as they cool.

recipes.title: Loaded Nachos
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Spread the chips on a tray, scatter with beans and cheese.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until melted.
Top with salsa, diced avocado, sour cream and sliced chili.

recipes.title: Spring Rolls in Lettuce Cups
steps: Soak or cook the noodles as the packet says, rinse in cold water and drain.
Mix the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chili and 2 tablespoons water for a dipping sauce.
Fill lettuce leaves with noodles, carrot, cucumber and herbs, roll up and dip in the sauce.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and line a loaf tin.
Mash the bananas, then stir in the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla.
Fold in the baking soda, salt, flour and walnuts until just combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 50 to 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and both sugars until creamy. Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate.
Roll into 16 balls, space well apart and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden at the edges. Cool on the tray.

recipes.title: Apple Crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F).
Peel and slice the apples and toss with the sugar and cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub the butter into the flour until it looks like breadcrumbs, then stir in the brown sugar and oats.
Scatter over the apples and bake for 35 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, cocoa and baking powder in a large mug.
Stir in the milk and oil until smooth, then push in the chocolate.
Microwave on high for 60 to 90 seconds until risen but still slightly gooey. Cool for a minute.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
steps: Put the rice, milk and sugar in a heavy saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook on low for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the vanilla and dust with nutmeg.

recipes.title: Easy Fruit Yogurt Bark
steps: Line a tray with baking paper.
Mix the yogurt and honey and spread about 1 cm thick.
Scatter with berries and chopped almonds. Freeze for 3 hours, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Oat Bites
steps: Mix all the ingredients well.
Chill for 20 minutes, then roll into about 18 balls. Keep in the fridge.

recipes.title: Vanilla Cupcakes
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a muffin tin with 12 cases.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Fold in the flour and milk. Divide between the cases and bake for 18 to 20 minutes. Cool.
Beat the frosting butter with the powdered sugar and a splash of milk until fluffy and pipe or spread on top.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a muffin tin.
Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Whisk the egg, milk and oil, then stir into the dry mix until just combined. Fold in the blueberries.
Fill the cases and bake for 20 to 22 minutes until risen and golden.

recipes.title: Chocolate Avocado Mousse
steps: Blend everything until completely smooth.
Spoon into small glasses and chill for 30 minutes. Top with berries if you like.

recipes.title: Baked Cinnamon Apples
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F). Core the apples and stand them in a small dish.
Mix the butter, sugar, cinnamon, oats and raisins and stuff into the apples.
Add a splash of water to the dish and bake for 30 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Simple Pancake Crepes
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and salt to a smooth thin batter. Rest for 10 minutes if you can.
Heat a non-stick pan and wipe with butter. Pour in a thin layer of batter, swirling to coat.
Cook for 1 minute until set, flip and cook 30 seconds.
Serve sprinkled with sugar and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Easy Pad Thai

ingredients.name: Limes, one juiced, one in wedges

steps: Soak the noodles in hot water until just soft, then drain.
Mix the fish sauce, sugar, the juice of one lime and the tomato paste.
Stir-fry the garlic and shrimp in the oil for 2 minutes. Push aside, scramble the eggs in the space.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes. Add the bean sprouts and green onions.
Serve topped with chopped peanuts and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Hearty Beef Stew
steps: Toss the beef in seasoned flour and brown in batches in the oil. Set aside.
Cook the chopped onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste.
Return the beef, add the stock, bay leaves and thyme. Cover and simmer gently for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the potatoes in chunks and cook 45 minutes more, until the beef is tender. Season.

recipes.title: Coconut Fish Curry
steps: Cook the sliced onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the fish and simmer gently for 5 to 6 minutes until it flakes.
Season, squeeze over the lime and scatter with cilantro. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken Orzo
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil, season and remove.
Cook the chopped onion for 5 minutes, add the garlic and oregano, then the orzo for 1 minute.
Add the stock, return the chicken and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring, until the orzo is tender.
Stir in the spinach, lemon zest and juice. Crumble over the feta.

recipes.title: Korean-Style Beef Rice Bowls
steps: Brown the beef in a hot pan, breaking it up.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and chili. Cook 2 minutes until glossy.
Serve over rice with sliced cucumber, green onions and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Baked Potatoes with Chili Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Prick the potatoes, rub with a little oil and salt and bake for 1 hour until crisp outside and soft inside.
Meanwhile cook the chopped onion in the rest of the oil for 6 minutes. Add the spices, beans and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Split the potatoes, spoon in the beans and top with cheese.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil and remove.
Stir-fry the cabbage and green onions in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes. Add the noodles and soy sauce and toss.
Fold the eggs back through and serve.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Baked Cod
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Put the tomatoes, olives and sliced garlic in a baking dish with the oil, toss and roast for 8 minutes.
Nestle in the fish, season, add lemon slices and bake 12 minutes more until the fish flakes.
Scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Garlic Ginger Bok Choy
steps: Rinse the bok choy well, shaking off most of the water.
Heat the oil in a wok or large pan over high heat. Add the garlic and ginger and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the bok choy cut side down and cook for 2 minutes, then turn and add 2 tablespoons of water. Cover for 2 minutes until the stems are just tender.
Toss with the soy sauce and sesame oil, scatter with sesame seeds and serve.

recipes.title: Crispy Tempeh Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice following the packet instructions.
Mix the soy sauce, maple syrup and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Fry the tempeh in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until golden. Pour in the sauce and let it bubble and coat the tempeh, about 1 minute.
Fill bowls with rice and top with the tempeh, carrot, cucumber and green onions. Add sriracha if you like heat.

recipes.title: Halloumi and Chickpea Traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).
Toss the chickpeas, peppers, onion and zucchini with the olive oil, paprika, cumin and a pinch of salt on a large tray. Roast for 20 minutes.
Add the halloumi, stir and roast for 10 minutes more until the cheese is golden at the edges.
Squeeze over the lemon and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Gochujang Pork Lettuce Wraps
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy sauce and honey together.
Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the pork and cook, breaking it up, for 6-8 minutes until browned.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then stir in the sauce and cook for 2 minutes until sticky.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with green onions and cucumber.

recipes.title: Black Bean Quesadillas

ingredients.name: Black beans, drained and lightly mashed

steps: Mix the beans, corn, jalapeno and cumin with a pinch of salt.
Spread the bean mix over half of each tortilla, top with cheese and fold over.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Miso Mushroom Udon
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the stock and bring to a simmer. Whisk the miso with a ladle of the hot stock and stir it back in with the soy sauce and mirin.
Add the noodles and spinach and simmer for 2-3 minutes until hot and wilted.
Serve in bowls topped with green onions.

recipes.title: Coconut Chana Masala
steps: Fry the onion in the oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Season, scatter with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and line a tray with baking paper.
Mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar. Rub in the butter until it looks like coarse crumbs with a few bigger pieces.
Stir in the buttermilk until just combined. Pat the dough out 2 cm thick, fold it over twice, and cut into 8 squares.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until tall and golden.

recipes.title: Blueberry Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar and salt in a bowl.
Beat the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter together, pour into the dry mix and stir until just combined.
Ladle about 3 tablespoons of batter into a lightly buttered pan over medium heat and scatter a few blueberries on top.
Cook until bubbles form and the edges look set, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 minute more.

recipes.title: Vegan Banana Pancakes

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil, plus extra for the pan

steps: Mash the bananas in a large bowl until smooth.
Stir in the oat milk and oil, then add the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and cinnamon and mix until just combined.
Cook spoonfuls of batter in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Classic Belgian-Style Waffles
steps: Heat the waffle iron and brush it lightly with butter.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Beat the milk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla, then stir into the dry mix until smooth.
Pour enough batter to cover the iron plates, close and cook for 4-5 minutes until crisp and golden.
Keep the waffles warm on a rack in a low oven while you cook the rest.

recipes.title: Spinach and Cheese Egg Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and grease a 12-hole muffin tin with cooking spray.
Divide the spinach, pepper and cheese between the holes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables, filling each hole about three-quarters full.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until puffed and set in the middle. Cool for 5 minutes before lifting out.

recipes.title: Sausage and Potato Breakfast Hash
steps: Boil the potato cubes in salted water for 5 minutes, then drain well.
Brown the sausage meat in the oil in a large frying pan, breaking it up, for 5 minutes. Add the onion, pepper and potatoes.
Season with paprika and salt and fry for 12-15 minutes, turning now and then, until the potatoes are crisp.
Make four hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Chilaquiles Rojos

ingredients.name: Onion, half chopped and half thinly sliced

steps: Blend the tomatoes, chopped onion, garlic, jalapeno and stock until smooth.
Heat the oil in a large pan, pour in the sauce and simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thickened. Season with salt.
Meanwhile fry the eggs in another pan.
Fold the tortilla chips into the sauce until coated, then top straight away with the eggs, sliced onion, queso fresco and cilantro.

recipes.title: Turkish-Style Eggs with Yogurt
steps: Stir the garlic and a pinch of salt into the yogurt and spread it over four plates.
Bring a wide pan of water to a gentle simmer with the vinegar. Poach the eggs, a few at a time, for 3 minutes.
Melt the butter until foaming and stir in the aleppo pepper.
Lift two eggs onto each plate of yogurt, spoon over the spiced butter and scatter with dill. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Breakfast Quesadillas
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble them softly in the butter. Stir in the green onions.
Spread the egg over half of each tortilla, add the cheese and fold over.
Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie Bowls
steps: Blend the frozen banana, peanut butter, almond milk and cocoa until thick and smooth, adding a splash more milk if needed.
Spoon into bowls and top with granola and chia seeds. Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal with Apples
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan) and butter a medium baking dish.
Mix the oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Whisk the milk, egg, maple syrup and butter, then stir everything together with the apple.
Pour into the dish, scatter with walnuts and bake for 35 minutes until golden and just set.

recipes.title: Savory Cheddar Scones
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and line a tray.
Rub the butter into the flour, baking powder, salt and mustard powder until it looks like breadcrumbs. Stir in most of the cheese.
Add the milk and bring together into a soft dough. Pat out 3 cm thick and cut 8 rounds.
Brush with egg, top with the rest of the cheese and bake for 15-18 minutes until risen and golden.

recipes.title: Congee with Ginger and Green Onion
steps: Rinse the rice, then bring it to a boil with the stock and half the ginger in a large pot.
Lower the heat and simmer, partly covered, for about 1 hour, stirring every 10 minutes, until thick and creamy. Add water if it gets too thick.
Season with soy sauce and white pepper and ladle into bowls.
Top with the green onions, the remaining ginger and a few drops of sesame oil.

recipes.title: Tamagoyaki-Style Rolled Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with the mirin, soy sauce and sugar until even but not frothy.
Wipe a non-stick frying pan with oil and set over medium-low heat. Pour in a thin layer of egg and let it nearly set.
Roll the egg up from the far side towards you, push the roll back, oil the pan again and pour in another thin layer, lifting the roll so egg runs underneath.
Roll again and repeat until the egg is used. Rest for 2 minutes, then slice.

recipes.title: Masala Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with the onion, tomato, chili, cilantro, turmeric and salt.
Heat half a tablespoon of ghee in a small frying pan over medium heat and pour in a quarter of the mix.
Cook for 2 minutes until almost set, then fold and cook 30 seconds more. Repeat to make four omelettes.

recipes.title: Poha with Peas and Peanuts
steps: Rinse the poha in a sieve under cold water for 30 seconds, then leave to drain and soften.
Heat the oil and fry the peanuts until golden, then add the mustard seeds and curry leaves until they crackle.
Add the onion and chili and cook 4 minutes, then the turmeric and peas for 2 minutes.
Fold in the poha with the sugar and a good pinch of salt, cover for 2 minutes on low heat, then squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.title: Breakfast Fried Rice
steps: Fry the bacon in the oil in a large pan or wok until crisp. Push it to one side.
Scramble the eggs in the space until just set, then break them up.
Add the rice and peas and stir-fry over high heat for 4-5 minutes until hot and starting to crisp.
Stir in the soy sauce and green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash with Black Beans

ingredients.name: Sweet potatoes, cut into 1.5 cm cubes

steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan and add the sweet potato. Cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the onion, pepper, paprika, cumin and a pinch of salt and cook uncovered for 10 minutes until the potato is crisp at the edges.
Stir in the black beans to warm through for 3 minutes. Top with avocado.

recipes.title: Coconut Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk the coconut milk, almond milk, chia seeds, maple syrup and vanilla in a bowl.
Leave for 10 minutes, whisk again to break up any clumps, then cover and chill for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Spoon into glasses and top with the mango.

recipes.title: Bacon and Egg Breakfast Sandwiches
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp and drain on paper towels.
Fry the eggs in the butter, breaking the yolks if you like, until set.
Toast the muffins. Layer each base with cheese, an egg and two slices of bacon, then close.

recipes.title: Granola with Nuts and Honey
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan) and line a large tray.
Mix the oats, almonds, seeds, cinnamon and salt. Warm the honey and oil together, pour over and stir until everything is coated.
Spread out on the tray and bake for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Stir in the raisins and let cool completely; it crisps as it cools. Store in a jar.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar French Toast Sticks
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and vanilla in a shallow dish. Mix the sugar and cinnamon on a plate.
Dip the bread sticks briefly into the egg, letting the excess drip off.
Fry in batches in the butter over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Roll the hot sticks in the cinnamon sugar and serve.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Thyme Toast
steps: Melt the butter in a large pan over high heat, add the mushrooms and cook without stirring for 3 minutes until browned.
Add the garlic and thyme, season with salt and pepper and cook 3 minutes more.
Toast the bread, spoon over the mushrooms, add a dollop of creme fraiche and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Huevos a la Mexicana
steps: Fry the onion and jalapeno in the oil for 3 minutes, then add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently over medium heat until softly set.
Serve with warm corn tortillas.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, grated apple, maple syrup, cinnamon and chia seeds together.
Divide between four jars, cover and chill overnight.
Top with chopped pecans in the morning. Eat cold or warm briefly in the microwave.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Bagels
steps: Spread the cream cheese over the toasted bagel halves.
Top with the salmon, onion and capers.
Finish with dill, a squeeze of lemon and some black pepper.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Breakfast Strata
steps: Butter a 20 x 30 cm baking dish and layer in the bread, ham, green onions and most of the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard and a pinch of salt and pour over. Press the bread down and leave for 15 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Scatter over the rest of the cheese and bake for 40-45 minutes until puffed and set.

recipes.title: Polenta Breakfast Bowls with Fried Eggs
steps: Bring the milk and a pinch of salt to a simmer and whisk in the polenta. Cook, stirring, for 5-8 minutes until thick, then stir in the butter and parmesan.
Fry the tomatoes in the oil for 3 minutes, push aside and fry the eggs.
Spoon the polenta into bowls and top with the eggs and tomatoes.

recipes.title: Quinoa Breakfast Porridge
steps: Simmer the quinoa with the almond milk, water and cinnamon for 15-20 minutes, stirring now and then, until creamy and tender.
Stir in the maple syrup and a pinch of salt.
Serve topped with blueberries and almonds.

recipes.title: Egg and Avocado Breakfast Tacos
steps: Scramble the eggs in the butter with a pinch of salt over low heat until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with egg and avocado, then top with cotija and salsa verde.

recipes.title: Dutch Baby Pancake
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) with a 25 cm ovenproof frying pan inside.
Blend the eggs, flour, milk, sugar and salt until smooth.
Add the butter to the hot pan and swirl until melted, then pour in the batter.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until puffed and deep golden. Squeeze over lemon, dust with powdered sugar and serve at once.

recipes.title: Green Breakfast Smoothie
steps: Put everything in a blender with a handful of ice.
Blend until completely smooth and pour into glasses.

recipes.title: Fruit and Nut Muesli
steps: Mix everything together and store in an airtight jar.
Serve with cold milk or yogurt, or soak in milk overnight with a grated apple for a softer bowl.

recipes.title: Gallo Pinto

ingredients.name: Black beans, with a little of their liquid

steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beans with about 4 tablespoons of their liquid and simmer for 3 minutes.
Fold in the rice and Worcestershire sauce and stir-fry until hot and evenly colored. Finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Caribbean Fish and Egg Scramble
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes, habanero and thyme for 3 minutes.
Add the fish and cook 2 minutes, then pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Season with salt and black pepper and serve with bread or fried plantain.

recipes.title: Penne alla Vodka-Style Tomato Cream
steps: Cook the penne in salted water until al dente. Save a mug of the cooking water before draining.
Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, chili flakes and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes until the paste darkens.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes, then stir in the cream.
Toss in the pasta with the parmesan and a splash of pasta water until glossy.

recipes.title: Cacio e Pepe
steps: Cook the spaghetti in a smaller amount of salted water than usual so the water gets starchy. Save 300 ml before draining.
Toast the pepper in a large pan for 1 minute, add the butter and 150 ml pasta water and bring to a simmer.
Add the pasta, take the pan off the heat and wait 30 seconds, then add the cheese a handful at a time, tossing hard and adding water until creamy.

recipes.title: Pasta e Ceci
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, rosemary and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and stock, simmer for 10 minutes, then mash about a third of the chickpeas against the pan.
Add the pasta and cook, stirring often, until tender and the soup is thick, about 10 minutes. Remove the rosemary and serve with parmesan.

recipes.title: Puttanesca
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic, anchovies and chili flakes until the anchovies melt.
Add the tomatoes, olives and capers and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and toss with the sauce and parsley.

recipes.title: Sausage and Broccoli Orecchiette-Style Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta; add the broccoli for the last 4 minutes. Save a mug of water and drain.
Brown the sausage in the oil, breaking it up, for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Toss in the pasta and broccoli with a splash of water and the parmesan until glossy.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Tagliatelle
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Brown the mushrooms in the butter over high heat for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted.
Toss with the drained pasta and parmesan, loosening with pasta water if needed.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain.
Brown the beef with the onion for 8 minutes, then add the marinara and oregano and simmer 5 minutes.
Mix the pasta with the sauce and spread half in a baking dish. Dot with ricotta, add the rest of the pasta and top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until bubbling and browned.

recipes.title: Lemon Ricotta Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes. Save a mug of water.
Mix the ricotta, lemon zest and juice, parmesan, oil and plenty of black pepper in a large bowl.
Toss in the hot pasta and peas with enough water to make it creamy, then tear in the basil.

recipes.title: Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Fry the zucchini, pepper and asparagus in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta, a splash of pasta water and the parmesan.

recipes.title: Vegan Creamy Cashew Pasta

ingredients.name: Cashews, soaked in hot water for 15 minutes

steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Drain the cashews and blend with the stock, nutritional yeast, garlic, lemon juice and a pinch of salt until silky.
Drain the pasta, return to the pot with the spinach and sauce and stir over low heat until the spinach wilts.

recipes.title: Tuna and Tomato Spaghetti
steps: Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes and capers and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the tuna to warm through.
Toss with the cooked spaghetti and parsley.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Sage Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Fry the sage leaves in the butter until crisp, lift out, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the pumpkin, stock and nutmeg and simmer 3 minutes. Toss with the pasta and parmesan and top with the crispy sage.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chicken Alfredo
steps: Brown the chicken in the butter for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the stock and cream and bring to a simmer, then add the pasta (break it in half if needed).
Simmer, stirring often, for 12-14 minutes until the pasta is tender and the sauce coats it. Stir in the parmesan and parsley.

recipes.title: Spaghetti with Garlic Breadcrumbs
steps: Toast the breadcrumbs in 2 tablespoons of oil until golden, then stir in the lemon zest and a pinch of salt.
Cook the spaghetti. Warm the rest of the oil with the garlic, anchovies and chili until the garlic is pale gold.
Toss the pasta in the garlic oil with parsley and a splash of pasta water, then scatter the crumbs over.

recipes.title: Orzo with Spinach and Feta
steps: Fry the garlic in the oil for 30 seconds, add the orzo and stir 1 minute.
Add the stock and simmer, stirring often, for 10-12 minutes until the orzo is tender and creamy.
Stir in the spinach, lemon juice, dill and most of the feta. Top with the rest of the feta.

recipes.title: Lo Mein with Vegetables
steps: Cook the noodles, rinse in cold water and drain.
Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil and sugar.
Stir-fry the carrots and mushrooms in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes, add the snow peas, garlic and green onions for 1 minute.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes until hot.

recipes.title: Sesame Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, honey and chili garlic sauce with 4 tablespoons of warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce and top with cucumber, green onions and sesame seeds. Serve cold or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Dan Dan-Style Pork Noodles
steps: Fry the pork in the oil until browned and crispy, about 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and cook 1 minute.
Whisk the rest of the soy sauce with the tahini, chili oil, vinegar and 4 tablespoons of hot water. Divide between bowls.
Cook the noodles, adding the bok choy for the last minute. Drain and divide between the bowls.
Top with the pork and green onions and stir everything together at the table.

recipes.title: Yaki Udon
steps: Loosen the udon in hot water for 1 minute and drain.
Fry the pork in the oil until golden, then add the onion, carrot and cabbage and stir-fry 4 minutes.
Add the noodles with the soy sauce, mirin and Worcestershire sauce and toss over high heat for 2-3 minutes.

recipes.title: Cold Soba Noodle Salad
steps: Cook the soba with the edamame for 4-5 minutes, then rinse under cold water until cool and drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and sugar.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and dressing and top with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Thai Drunken Noodles
steps: Soak or cook the noodles following the packet, then drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chilies and pepper for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles with the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar and toss for 2 minutes. Stir in the basil until wilted.

recipes.title: Japchae
steps: Cook the noodles following the packet, rinse and cut into shorter lengths with scissors.
Blanch the spinach for 30 seconds, squeeze dry and chop.
Stir-fry the onion, carrot and mushrooms in the vegetable oil for 4 minutes, adding the garlic at the end.
Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar, then toss everything together with the noodles and spinach. Finish with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Singapore-Style Curry Noodles
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water until soft, then drain.
Scramble the eggs in a little oil, then set aside. Stir-fry the shrimp in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the pepper and curry powder for 1 minute, then the noodles, soy sauce and a splash of water. Toss until evenly yellow.
Add the egg, bean sprouts and green onions and toss once more.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles in salted water and drain, saving a little water.
Melt the butter and cook the garlic gently for 2 minutes without browning.
Toss the noodles with the garlic butter, parmesan, parsley and a splash of water.

recipes.title: Chicken Ramen Bowls
steps: Simmer the stock with the ginger and garlic, add the chicken and poach gently for 15 minutes. Lift out and slice.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Whisk the soy sauce and miso into the broth and remove the ginger and garlic. Cook the noodles separately.
Divide noodles and spinach between bowls, ladle over the hot broth and top with chicken, halved eggs and green onions.

recipes.title: Spicy Gochujang Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and drain, saving a little water.
Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil and garlic in the pot, add the noodles and a splash of water and toss over low heat.
Serve topped with fried eggs and green onions.

recipes.title: Pad See Ew
steps: Soften the noodles following the packet and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken and garlic in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes, then add the broccolini for 2 minutes.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then add the noodles and sauces. Toss and let the noodles char a little, about 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Tortellini in Brodo with Spinach
steps: Bring the stock to a boil and season to taste.
Add the tortellini and simmer following the packet, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve with parmesan and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Gnocchi with Brown Butter and Sage
steps: Cook the gnocchi in salted water until they float, then drain.
Melt the butter with the sage over medium heat until nutty and golden, about 3 minutes.
Add the gnocchi and toss for 2 minutes so they color slightly. Finish with parmesan, lemon and black pepper.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Gnocchi with Sausage and Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).
Toss the uncooked gnocchi, sausage, peppers and onion with the oil, seasoning and a pinch of salt on a large tray.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway, until the gnocchi are golden and the sausage is cooked. Top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Spinach Ricotta Stuffed Shells-Style Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Cook the pasta 2 minutes under the packet time and drain.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, egg, half the parmesan and a pinch of nutmeg and salt.
Spread half the sauce in a baking dish, add the pasta mixed with the ricotta mixture, then the rest of the sauce.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake for 25-30 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.title: Mac and Cheese on the Stove
steps: Cook the macaroni in salted water and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute. Whisk in the milk and simmer 3 minutes until thick.
Take off the heat, stir in the cheese and mustard powder until smooth, then fold in the pasta.

recipes.title: Linguine with Clams
steps: Cook the linguine until just short of al dente.
Warm the oil with the garlic and chili, add the clams and wine, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until they open. Discard any that stay closed.
Add the pasta and a splash of its water to the clams and toss for 1 minute. Finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff over Egg Noodles
steps: Sear the beef in half the butter over high heat for 1-2 minutes, in batches, and set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the rest of the butter for 8 minutes. Sprinkle in the flour, then stir in the stock and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and mustard, return the beef and warm through without boiling.
Serve over the cooked noodles.

recipes.title: Cheesy Taco Pasta
steps: Brown the beef in a large pan for 6 minutes and drain off excess fat. Stir in the taco seasoning.
Add the tomatoes, stock and macaroni, bring to a boil and simmer, covered, for 10-12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in most of the cheese, top with the rest and the green onions, and cover for a minute to melt.

recipes.title: Chicken Biryani

ingredients.name: Saffron, soaked in 3 tbsp warm milk

steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, ginger garlic paste, spices and 1 teaspoon of salt. Leave for 20 minutes or longer.
Fry the onions in the ghee for 12 minutes until deep golden. Remove half for the top.
Parboil the rice in salted water for 5 minutes and drain.

Add the chicken to the pot with the remaining onions and cook 10 minutes. Layer the rice over, drizzle with the saffron milk, scatter with mint and fried onion. Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mujaddara
steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 15 minutes until just tender; drain.
Fry the onions slowly in the oil for 25-30 minutes until deep brown and some are crisp. Lift out half.
Add the rice, cumin and cinnamon to the pan and stir 1 minute, then add the lentils, 500 ml water and 1 teaspoon salt.
Cover and cook on low for 18 minutes, then rest 5 minutes. Serve topped with the reserved onions and yogurt.

recipes.title: Jollof Rice
steps: Blend the tomatoes, peppers, habanero and one onion until smooth.
Slice the other onion and fry in the oil for 5 minutes, add the tomato paste and fry 3 minutes, then add the blended sauce, curry powder, thyme and bay leaves. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Stir in the rinsed rice and stock, season with salt, cover tightly and cook on low for 25-30 minutes, without stirring, until the rice is tender.

recipes.title: Arroz con Pollo
steps: Season the chicken with salt, cumin and paprika and brown in the oil for 4 minutes per side. Set aside.
Fry the onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste, saffron and rice.
Add the stock, nestle the chicken back in, cover and simmer on low for 25 minutes.
Scatter over the peas, cover again for 5 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice

ingredients.name: Kimchi, chopped, plus 3 tbsp of its juice

steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, add the kimchi and fry 3 minutes.
Add the rice, gochujang, kimchi juice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 5 minutes until hot and a little crispy.
Stir in the sesame oil. Fry the eggs and serve on top with green onions.

recipes.title: Mexican Rice
steps: Fry the rice in the oil over medium heat for 4-5 minutes until lightly golden.
Add the onion and garlic for 2 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste, cumin and stock with a pinch of salt.
Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Cilantro Lime Rice
steps: Rinse the rice, then bring to a boil with the water, oil and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 15-18 minutes until the water is absorbed. Rest 5 minutes.
Fluff and fold in the lime zest, juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Quinoa
steps: Simmer the quinoa in the stock, covered, for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed. Rest 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and fold in the lemon zest and juice, olive oil and parsley.

recipes.title: Mushroom Barley Risotto
steps: Cook the onion and mushrooms in the butter for 8 minutes until golden. Add the garlic and thyme.
Stir in the barley, then add the stock a ladleful at a time over 40 minutes, stirring often, until tender and creamy.
Stir in the parmesan and season well.

recipes.title: Pea and Parmesan Risotto
steps: Soften the onion in the oil and half the butter for 5 minutes. Add the rice and stir 1 minute.
Add the wine and let it bubble away, then add the stock a ladleful at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
Add the peas with the last of the stock. When the rice is just tender, stir in the rest of the butter, parmesan and lemon zest.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Risotto
steps: Cook the squash and onion in the oil for 10 minutes until the squash starts to soften.
Add the rice and sage and stir 1 minute, then add the hot stock a ladleful at a time, stirring often, for 18-20 minutes.
Beat in the butter and parmesan; some squash will break down and make it creamy.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Grits
steps: Simmer the grits in the milk with a pinch of salt, stirring often, for 15-20 minutes until thick. Stir in the cheddar.
Fry the bacon until crisp. Toss the shrimp with the Cajun seasoning and cook in the bacon fat with the garlic for 3 minutes.
Squeeze over the lemon and spoon onto the grits with the bacon and green onions.

recipes.title: Dirty Rice
steps: Brown the pork in a large pot for 6 minutes. Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook 6 minutes, then the garlic and Cajun seasoning.
Stir in the rice and stock, bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and fold in the green onions.

recipes.title: Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice
steps: Fry the chorizo until it releases its oil, then brown the chicken in it for 5 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper and garlic for 5 minutes, then the paprika and rice.
Pour in the tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer on low for 20 minutes until the rice is tender. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice and Beans
steps: Bring the coconut milk, water, green onions, thyme, allspice, garlic and 1 teaspoon salt to a simmer.
Stir in the rice and beans, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the eggs and stir until just set.
Add the rice and stir-fry for 4 minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions and toss for 1 minute.

recipes.title: Pineapple Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry the onion and shrimp in the oil for 3 minutes. Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and curry powder and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add the pineapple, cashews, soy sauce and fish sauce and toss until hot.

recipes.title: Stuffed Cabbage Rice Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan).
Brown the beef and onion in an ovenproof pot for 8 minutes. Stir in the paprika and rice.
Add the cabbage, tomatoes, sugar, vinegar and stock, season and bring to a simmer.
Cover and bake for 40-45 minutes until the rice and cabbage are tender.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak the bulgur in boiling water for 15 minutes, then drain and squeeze dry.
Mix with the tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, parsley and mint.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil and salt. It should taste bright and lemony.

recipes.title: Herbed Couscous with Chickpeas
steps: Put the couscous, cumin and raisins in a bowl, pour over the boiling stock, cover and leave 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the chickpeas, olive oil, lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.title: Farro Salad with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Simmer the farro in salted water for 25-30 minutes until chewy-tender, then drain.
Roast the vegetables with 2 tablespoons oil at 220°C (200°C fan) for 25 minutes.
Toss the farro, vegetables, arugula, the rest of the oil and the vinegar, then top with feta.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Brown the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the teriyaki sauce and simmer 2 minutes until glossy.
Serve the chicken over rice with broccoli and carrot and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Burrito Bowls
steps: Cook the rice and stir in the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Rub the chicken with taco seasoning and pan-fry for 6 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
Warm the beans and corn together.
Build bowls with rice, beans and corn, chicken, avocado, salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Vegan Burrito Bowls with Spiced Lentils
steps: Cook the rice following the packet.
Simmer the lentils in water for 20 minutes until tender, drain and stir in the taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Warm the beans. Build bowls with rice, lentils, beans, avocado and tomatoes, then add lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Fried Plantains and Black Bean Rice

ingredients.name: Black beans, with a little liquid

steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the onion and pepper in 2 tablespoons oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, cumin and oregano, then the beans. Simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few.
Fry the plantain slices in the rest of the oil for 2-3 minutes per side until caramelized.
Serve the beans over rice with the plantains.

recipes.title: Bibimbap
steps: Cook the rice. Fry the beef with 2 tablespoons soy sauce and the sugar until browned.
Separately cook each vegetable quickly in a little sesame oil with a pinch of salt: spinach 1 minute, carrots and zucchini 2 minutes, sprouts 1 minute.
Fry the eggs. Mix the gochujang with the rest of the soy sauce and 1 tablespoon water.
Arrange beef and vegetables over the rice, add an egg and a spoon of the sauce, then mix everything at the table.

recipes.title: Onigiri Rice Balls
steps: Cook the rice and leave until cool enough to handle.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise.
Wet your hands and rub with a little salt. Take a handful of rice, press a hollow, add a teaspoon of tuna and shape into a triangle.
Wrap a strip of nori around the base of each ball.

recipes.title: Lemon Rice
steps: Heat the oil and add the mustard seeds, chana dal and peanuts. Fry until the dal is golden.
Add the curry leaves, chili and turmeric for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and a teaspoon of salt and toss until evenly yellow. Stir in the lemon juice.

recipes.title: Jeera Rice
steps: Rinse the rice and soak for 15 minutes, then drain.
Fry the cumin seeds and bay leaves in the ghee until fragrant, add the rice and stir 1 minute.
Add the water and a teaspoon of salt, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes. Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Paella with Chicken and Shrimp
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pan. Add the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes, then stir in the rice, saffron and hot stock. Spread evenly and do not stir again.
Simmer for 15 minutes, then press in the shrimp and scatter over the peas. Cook 8 minutes more until the rice is tender and a crust forms underneath.
Rest for 5 minutes under a towel and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Polenta with Mushroom Ragu
steps: Cook the onion and mushrooms in the oil for 10 minutes, then add the garlic, rosemary and tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Bring the stock to a boil and whisk in the polenta. Cook, stirring, until thick, about 5-10 minutes, then stir in the parmesan.
Spoon the polenta into bowls and top with the ragu.

recipes.title: Wild Rice Pilaf with Cranberries
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the butter for 6 minutes.
Add both rices and the stock, bring to a boil, cover and simmer for 45 minutes until tender. Drain any extra liquid.
Fold in the cranberries and pecans.

recipes.title: Chicken Congee-Style Rice Soup
steps: Bring the stock, rice and ginger to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the chicken and simmer 12 minutes until cooked. Lift out, shred and return to the pot.
Season with fish sauce and serve topped with green onions, cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Rice
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the rice and stir 1 minute.
Add the stock, lemon zest and a pinch of salt, cover and cook on low for 15-18 minutes.
Fluff and fold in the lemon juice and dill.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, half the ginger garlic paste, 1 teaspoon garam masala, the chili powder and salt. Leave 15 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken over high heat until charred in places, about 8 minutes.
Melt the butter, cook the onion 6 minutes, add the rest of the paste and garam masala, then the tomatoes and sugar. Simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in the cream, kasuri methi and chicken and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Toss the chicken with the yogurt, half the spices and salt, then grill or sear in a hot pan until charred.
Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and the rest of the spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then blend smooth if you like.
Stir in the coconut cream and chicken and simmer 8 minutes. Scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Jerk Chicken Thighs
steps: Blend the jerk seasoning, green onions, habanero, soy sauce, lime juice, oil and sugar into a paste.
Rub all over the chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Roast at 210°C (190°C fan) for 35 minutes, or grill over medium heat, until charred and cooked through.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Wraps
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices, garlic, lemon juice, oil and salt. Leave 15 minutes or longer.
Cook in a hot pan or under the grill for 6-7 minutes per side until charred. Rest and slice thinly.
Mix the yogurt and tahini with a pinch of salt.
Fill the warm pita with chicken, tomato, cucumber and the sauce, and roll up.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
steps: Season the chicken and dust with flour.
Fry in the oil and half the butter for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
Add the garlic, stock, lemon juice and capers to the pan and boil 3 minutes until reduced by half.
Whisk in the rest of the butter, return the chicken and spoon over the sauce. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil and seasoning on a large tray, spreading them out.
Roast for 20-25 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the vegetables have charred edges. Squeeze over the lime.
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (190°C fan).
Toss the chicken and potatoes with the lemon juice, oil, garlic, oregano and plenty of salt and pepper in a roasting pan.
Pour the stock around the potatoes and roast for 50 minutes, turning the potatoes once, until the chicken is golden and the potatoes have soaked up the juices.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan).
Mix the chicken with the onion, cumin, half the cheese and 150 ml of the sauce.
Spread a little sauce in a baking dish. Roll the filling in the tortillas and lay them seam side down. Pour over the rest of the sauce and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until bubbling. Serve with sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
steps: Toss the chicken with 2 tablespoons soy sauce, the turmeric, curry powder and sugar. Thread onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry for 4-5 minutes per side until charred and cooked.
Simmer the peanut butter, coconut milk, chili sauce, remaining soy sauce and lime juice for 3 minutes, stirring, until smooth.
Serve the skewers with the sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Thai Green Chicken Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute, then add the chicken and stir to coat.
Add the coconut milk, stock and eggplant and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the green beans and simmer 4 minutes, then season with the fish sauce and sugar. Stir in the basil and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken

ingredients.name: Dried ancho chilies, or other dried chilies, snipped

steps: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce. Mix the rest of the soy sauce with the vinegar, sugar, hoisin and 3 tablespoons water.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil for 5 minutes until browned. Add the dried chilies, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
