Pour in the sauce and toss until glossy, then add the peanuts and green onions.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
steps: Toss the chicken in 2 tablespoons cornstarch with a pinch of salt and fry in the oil until golden and cooked, about 6 minutes. Set aside.
Stir-fry the pepper and onion for 3 minutes, then add the pineapple.
Mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, the remaining cornstarch and 100 ml water. Add to the pan and bubble until thick, then return the chicken.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Season and brown the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes per side. Set aside.
Cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms for 8 minutes, add the garlic, then the wine and let it bubble 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and oregano, return the chicken and simmer, partly covered, for 35 minutes. Stir in the olives.

recipes.title: Coq au Vin-Style Braised Chicken
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, then brown the seasoned chicken in the fat. Set both aside.
Brown the shallots, mushrooms and carrots for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and flour and stir 1 minute.
Pour in the wine and stock, add the herbs and return the chicken and bacon. Cover and simmer gently for 50-60 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala-Style Mushroom Skillet
steps: Dust the seasoned chicken with flour and fry in the oil for 3-4 minutes per side. Set aside.
Melt the butter and brown the mushrooms for 6 minutes.
Add the wine and stock and boil 5 minutes until syrupy. Return the chicken for 2 minutes and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Wings
steps: Pat the wings very dry and toss with the baking powder, garlic powder and salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 22-25 minutes, shaking the basket every 8 minutes, until crisp and cooked through.
Toss with buffalo sauce and serve with ranch.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Breasts
steps: Rub the chicken with the oil, spices and salt.
Air fry at 190°C for 16-18 minutes, turning halfway, until the thickest part reaches 74°C.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Salsa Chicken
steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker, sprinkle with taco seasoning and pour over the salsa.
Cook on low for 4 hours (or high for 2.5 hours) until tender.
Shred the chicken with two forks, stir in the beans and corn and cook 15 minutes more. Serve in tacos, on rice or topped with cheese.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
steps: Whisk the honey, soy sauce, garlic, ginger and ketchup in the slow cooker and add the chicken.
Cook on low for 5 hours.
Mix the cornstarch with 3 tablespoons water, stir in and cook on high for 15 minutes until the sauce thickens. Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the butter for 8 minutes. Stir in the flour, then gradually add the stock and milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in the chicken and peas, season and pour into a baking dish.
Cover with the pastry, brush with egg, cut a vent and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the chicken in the oil, lemon juice, oregano, two-thirds of the garlic and salt for 20 minutes. Thread onto skewers.
Mix the yogurt, cucumber, dill and the rest of the garlic with a pinch of salt.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through. Serve with pita and tzatziki.

recipes.title: Tandoori-Style Baked Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Slash the drumsticks a few times and coat in the yogurt, tandoori paste, lemon juice and salt. Marinate 30 minutes or overnight.
Roast on a rack at 220°C (200°C fan) for 35-40 minutes, turning once, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with the onion rings and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo

ingredients.name: Black pepper, whole or coarsely ground

steps: Brown the chicken skin side down in the oil, then add all the other ingredients and 150 ml water.
Simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, turning the chicken once.
Uncover and simmer 10 minutes more until the sauce is glossy and reduced. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken with Apricots
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside. Soften the onion for 6 minutes and stir in the ras el hanout.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, apricots and stock and return the chicken.
Cover and simmer for 35-40 minutes until tender. Finish with cilantro and serve with couscous.

recipes.title: Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
steps: Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic, seasoning and salt and roll into 20 balls.
Brown in the oil for 6 minutes, turning.
Pour in the marinara, cover and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through. Serve with pasta or bread.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil with the onion and pepper for 8 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until thick.

recipes.title: Turkey Burgers
steps: Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire sauce, green onions and salt, and shape into 4 patties.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. Add the cheese for the last minute.
Serve in toasted buns with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu Curry
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in 1 tablespoon oil for 8 minutes, add the curry powder, then the stock, honey and soy sauce. Simmer 15 minutes and blend smooth. Thicken with cornstarch mixed with water.
Coat the chicken in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Slice and serve over rice with the curry sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and jalapeno in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the cumin, tomatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and beans and simmer 5 minutes. Add the lime juice and season.
Serve topped with crushed tortilla chips and avocado.

recipes.title: Chicken and Dumplings
steps: Soften the vegetables in the butter for 8 minutes, add the stock, thyme and chicken and simmer 20 minutes. Shred the chicken in the pot.
Mix the flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt, then stir in the milk to make a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto the simmering soup, cover and cook 15 minutes without lifting the lid, until the dumplings are fluffy.

recipes.title: Lemon Pepper Chicken Wings
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the wings with the oil, salt and garlic powder and spread on a rack over a tray.
Bake for 40 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp.
Toss with the butter, lemon zest, juice and pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Mix the chicken with the pepper and chili powder.
Fill half of each tortilla with chicken and cheese and fold.
Toast in a dry pan for 2-3 minutes per side until crisp. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Orange Chicken
steps: Toss the chicken in 3 tablespoons of cornstarch and fry in the oil until crisp and cooked, about 7 minutes.
Whisk the orange zest and juice, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, garlic, ginger and remaining cornstarch.
Pour into the pan and simmer until thick and glossy, then toss with the chicken. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in half the oil for 5 minutes until cooked. Set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the rest of the oil, then add the vegetables and rice and stir-fry 4 minutes.
Return the chicken with the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions and toss.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard and anchovy paste with black pepper.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and parmesan.
Fill the tortillas with lettuce and chicken and roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Coconut Chicken Curry with Spinach
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the paste and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir to coat, then add the coconut milk and tomatoes and simmer 18 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and pear and toss with the beef and onion. Marinate 15 minutes or longer.
Cook in batches in a very hot oiled pan for 2-3 minutes until caramelized.
Scatter with green onions and sesame seeds and serve with rice and kimchi.

recipes.title: Mongolian Beef
steps: Toss the beef in the cornstarch and fry in batches in hot oil until crisp, about 2 minutes per batch.
Pour off most of the oil, add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the soy sauce, sugar and 80 ml water. Simmer until syrupy.
Return the beef with the green onions and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Beef Fajitas
steps: Rub the steak with the seasoning, lime juice and 1 tablespoon oil. Leave 15 minutes.
Sear in a very hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side, then rest 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Cook the peppers and onion in the rest of the oil over high heat for 5 minutes.
Serve with warm tortillas and avocado.

recipes.title: Picadillo
steps: Brown the beef in the oil, then add the onion and pepper for 6 minutes and the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, olives and raisins and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper for 8 minutes and drain off excess fat.
Stir in the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, mustard and 100 ml water and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon into toasted buns.

recipes.title: Classic Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 minutes.
Mix with the beef, onion, eggs, Worcestershire sauce, thyme and 1 teaspoon salt. Shape into a loaf in a baking dish.
Mix the ketchup and sugar and spread over the top.
Bake for 55-60 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Cottage Pie with Cheddar Mash
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and carrot for 10 minutes, then add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes until soft, drain and mash with the butter, milk and half the cheese.
Spoon the beef into a dish, top with the mash and the rest of the cheese, and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Beef Kofta Kebabs
steps: Mix the lamb, onion, garlic, spices, parsley and 1 teaspoon salt. Shape into 12 sausages around skewers.
Grill or pan-fry for 10-12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve with pita and yogurt.

recipes.title: Steak with Chimichurri
steps: Mix the parsley, garlic, oregano, chili, vinegar, olive oil and a pinch of salt. Leave 10 minutes.
Season the steak and sear in the vegetable oil in a very hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 minutes, slice and spoon over the chimichurri.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
steps: Season the beef and brown it all over in a hot pan.
Put the vegetables in the slow cooker, set the beef on top and pour over the stock mixed with the tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce. Add the rosemary.
Cook on low for 8 hours until the beef falls apart. Skim the juices and serve as gravy.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Barbacoa

ingredients.name: Beef roast, cut into large chunks

steps: Blend the chipotles, garlic, onion, lime juice, cumin, oregano and stock.
Put the beef in the slow cooker with 1 teaspoon salt, pour over the sauce and add the bay leaves.
Cook on low for 8 hours. Shred the beef in the juices and serve in warm tortillas.

recipes.title: Korean Braised Short Ribs
steps: Soak the ribs in cold water for 20 minutes, drain, then boil for 5 minutes and rinse.
Mix the soy sauce, sugar, pear, garlic, ginger and 500 ml water in a heavy pot and add the ribs.
Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours, adding the carrots for the last 30 minutes, until very tender.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until glossy. Finish with sesame oil and green onions.

recipes.title: Pork Carnitas

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into large chunks

steps: Put the pork, orange juice, onion, garlic, spices, 2 teaspoons salt and enough water to half cover in a heavy pot. Simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Uncover and boil until the liquid is gone, then let the pork fry in its own fat until crisp, turning.
Shred and serve in warm tortillas.

recipes.title: Pork Souvlaki Pitas
steps: Marinate the pork in the oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic and salt for 20 minutes, then thread onto skewers.
Grill for 10-12 minutes, turning, until cooked.
Serve in warm pita with tomato, onion and yogurt.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Pork Tenderloin
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Season the pork and brown all over in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Mix the mustard, honey, rosemary and garlic and brush over the pork.
Roast for 15-18 minutes until it reaches 63°C inside. Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Mushroom Sauce
steps: Season the chops and cook in the oil for 4-5 minutes per side. Set aside.
Fry the mushrooms and shallot for 6 minutes, add the stock and thyme and reduce by half.
Stir in the cream, return the chops and simmer 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Pork Belly Bites
steps: Cook the pork in a dry pan over medium heat for 20 minutes, turning, until crisp and the fat has rendered. Pour off most of the fat.
Add the pepper and onion for 4 minutes.
Mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and 4 tablespoons water, pour in and toss until sticky.

recipes.title: Sausage and Peppers Skillet
steps: Brown the sausages in the oil for 8 minutes, then slice them.
Cook the peppers and onions for 10 minutes, add the garlic and tomatoes, and return the sausages.
Simmer 8 minutes. Serve as is or in rolls.

recipes.title: Toad in the Hole
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Put the sausages and oil in a roasting tin and bake 10 minutes.
Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, thyme and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Pour the batter around the hot sausages and bake for 25-30 minutes without opening the oven, until puffed and golden. Serve with gravy.

recipes.title: Lamb Rogan Josh
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in batches and set aside.
Fry the onions for 10 minutes, add the paste and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes.
Stir in the yogurt a spoonful at a time, return the lamb, add the bay leaves and 300 ml water.
Cover and simmer for 1.5 hours until tender.

recipes.title: Lamb Chops with Mint and Garlic
steps: Rub the chops with half the oil, the garlic, rosemary and salt.
Sear in a hot pan for 3 minutes per side for medium.
Mix the mint with the vinegar, honey and the rest of the oil and spoon over.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
steps: Cook the linguine.
Cook the shrimp in the oil and half the butter for 2 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then the wine and lemon juice and simmer 2 minutes.
Stir in the rest of the butter and parsley, then toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp Sheet Pan
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil and half the seasoning and roast 15 minutes.
Add the sausage and peppers with another tablespoon of oil and roast 10 minutes.
Toss the shrimp with the rest of the oil and seasoning, add to the tray and roast 6-8 minutes until pink. Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Shrimp Tacos with Lime Slaw
steps: Toss the cabbage with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha.
Toss the shrimp with the chili powder and salt and cook in the oil for 2-3 minutes.
Fill tortillas with slaw, shrimp, sauce and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Coconut Shrimp Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute, then add the coconut milk and pepper and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and snow peas and simmer 4 minutes until the shrimp are pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime and stir in the basil.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Salmon in Foil
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Lay the asparagus and salmon on a large sheet of foil.
Mix the butter and garlic and spoon over the salmon, top with lemon slices and season.
Fold the foil into a sealed parcel and bake for 15-18 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Miso Glazed Salmon
steps: Heat the grill (broiler) to high. Mix the miso, mirin, honey and soy sauce.
Spread over the salmon on a lined tray and grill for 8-10 minutes until caramelized and just cooked.
Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Salmon
steps: Rub the salmon with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 8-10 minutes until it flakes easily. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Fish and Chips
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chips with 2 tablespoons oil and salt and bake 20 minutes.
Coat the fish in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs. Lay on an oiled tray and drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Turn the chips, add the fish to the oven and bake both for 15 minutes until golden. Serve with lemon and tartar sauce.

recipes.title: Fish Curry with Tomato and Tamarind
steps: Fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves in the oil until they pop, then the onion for 6 minutes.
Add the paste and spices for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, tamarind and coconut milk. Simmer 10 minutes.
Slide in the fish and simmer gently for 6-8 minutes until it flakes.

recipes.title: Tuna Melts
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery and mustard with black pepper.
Spread over four slices of bread, top with cheese and the other slices.
Butter the outsides and toast in a pan for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and melted.

recipes.title: Salmon Patties
steps: Mix the salmon, breadcrumbs, egg, mayonnaise, green onions and lemon zest with salt and pepper. Shape into 8 patties.
Chill for 10 minutes if you have time.
Fry in the oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Mussels in White Wine and Garlic
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and soften the shallots and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the wine, bring to a boil, tip in the mussels, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes, shaking the pot, until open. Discard any that stay closed.
Stir in the cream and parsley and serve with bread for the juices.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry the shrimp in half the oil until pink, then set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the rest of the oil, add the carrot and peas for 2 minutes, then the rice for 4 minutes.
Return the shrimp with the soy sauce and green onions.

recipes.title: Baked Cod with Herb Crumb
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and lay the fish in an oiled dish.
Mix the breadcrumbs, parsley, lemon zest, butter, garlic and salt and press onto the fish.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the crumbs are golden and the fish flakes.

recipes.title: Thai Fish Cakes
steps: Blitz the fish with the curry paste, egg and fish sauce into a paste. Stir in the green beans.
With wet hands, shape into 16 small patties.
Fry in the oil for 2 minutes per side until golden and cooked. Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Seared Scallops with Lemon Butter
steps: Pat the scallops very dry and season.
Sear in the oil in a very hot pan for 1.5-2 minutes per side until deeply browned.
Add the butter and lemon juice, spoon over the scallops and sprinkle with chives.

recipes.title: Ham and Pineapple Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the ham in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes, then add the rice and stir-fry 4 minutes.
Add the pineapple, soy sauce, eggs and green onions and toss until hot.

recipes.title: Pork and Green Bean Stir-Fry

ingredients.name: Green beans, cut into short lengths

steps: Stir-fry the beans in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until blistered. Set aside.
Brown the pork for 5 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and doubanjiang for 1 minute.
Return the beans with the soy sauce and sugar and toss for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Steak Frites
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the fries with 2 tablespoons oil and salt and bake 30 minutes, turning once.
Mash the butter with the shallot, parsley and a pinch of salt.
Sear the steaks in the rest of the oil for 3-4 minutes per side. Rest and serve topped with the butter and the fries alongside.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Toss the beef in the cornstarch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce. Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the beef in hot oil for 2 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry the broccoli with 3 tablespoons water for 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, noodles, beef, oyster sauce and remaining soy sauce and toss until glossy.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden. Add the paste, chili and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes, then the chickpeas and 200 ml water. Simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer
steps: Wilt the spinach in a splash of water, then blend with the chili until smooth.
Fry the paneer in half the ghee until golden and set aside.
Fry the onion in the rest of the ghee for 6 minutes, add the paste and spices for 1 minute, then the spinach and a pinch of salt. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the cream and paneer and warm through.

recipes.title: Aloo Gobi
steps: Fry the cumin seeds in the oil until they sizzle, then the onion and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, cauliflower, turmeric, coriander and 1 teaspoon salt and stir to coat.
Add the tomatoes and 100 ml water, cover and cook on low for 18-20 minutes until tender. Stir in the garam masala and cilantro.

recipes.title: Dal Tadka
steps: Simmer the dal with the water and turmeric for 30 minutes until soft, then whisk smooth and season.
Heat the ghee, add the cumin seeds and garlic until golden, then the onion for 5 minutes and the tomatoes and chili for 3 minutes.
Pour the tadka over the dal, stir and scatter with cilantro.

recipes.title: Vegetable Korma
steps: Blend the cashews with half the coconut milk until smooth.
Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the paste and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, carrots, the cashew mix and the rest of the coconut milk. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the beans and peas and simmer 5 minutes until everything is tender.

recipes.title: Thai Red Vegetable Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute. Add the coconut milk, stock and sweet potato and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the pepper, broccoli and tofu and simmer 6 minutes.
Season with the soy sauce and lime juice. Check that your curry paste is vegan if needed; many contain shrimp.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu
steps: Gently simmer the tofu in salted water for 2 minutes and drain.
Fry the pork in the oil until browned, then add the doubanjiang, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the stock and soy sauce, slide in the tofu and simmer 5 minutes.
Thicken with the cornstarch mixed with water, drizzle with chili oil and scatter with green onions.

recipes.title: Crispy Sesame Tofu
steps: Toss the tofu in the cornstarch with a pinch of salt.
Fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until crisp on all sides.
Mix the soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar and sriracha, pour into the pan and toss until sticky. Finish with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.title: Tofu Pad Thai
steps: Soak the noodles following the packet and drain. Mix the tamarind, soy sauce and sugar.
Fry the tofu in 2 tablespoons oil until golden, then set aside.
Fry the garlic in the rest of the oil, add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes.
Add the tofu, bean sprouts and green onions and toss once more. Serve with peanuts and lime.

recipes.title: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the tomato paste, lentils, stock and thyme and simmer 25 minutes until thick.
Boil the potatoes until soft and mash with the oat milk, vegan butter and salt.
Spread the lentils in a dish, top with mash and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Black Bean Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Soften the onion in the oil, then stir in the beans, corn and cumin and mash lightly.
Spread a little sauce in a dish. Warm the tortillas so they bend, fill and roll, and place seam side down.
Pour over the rest of the sauce, top with cheese and bake for 20-25 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Paella
steps: Fry the onion, pepper and beans in the oil for 6 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.
Add the tomatoes for 5 minutes, then stir in the rice, saffron and hot stock. Spread out and do not stir again.
Simmer for 20 minutes, adding the artichokes halfway, until the rice is tender with a slight crust. Rest 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Prick the sweet potatoes and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 45 minutes until soft (or microwave for 10-12 minutes).
Warm the beans with the cumin and a pinch of salt.
Split the potatoes and fill with beans, avocado, salsa, sour cream and green onions.

recipes.title: Falafel Bowls with Tahini
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, flour and 1 teaspoon salt until coarse but holding together. Shape into 16 small patties.
Brush with oil and bake at 220°C (200°C fan) for 20 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, a pinch of salt and enough water to make it pourable.
Serve the falafel with cucumber and tomatoes and drizzle with the sauce.

recipes.title: Eggplant and Chickpea Tagine
steps: Fry the eggplant in 3 tablespoons oil for 8 minutes until browned. Set aside.
Soften the onion in the rest of the oil, stir in the ras el hanout, then add the tomatoes, chickpeas, apricots and stock.
Return the eggplant and simmer, covered, for 25 minutes. Finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Lentil Bolognese
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and mushrooms in the oil for 10 minutes until the mushrooms are browned. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, oregano and 300 ml water and simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Serve over the cooked spaghetti.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni-Style Rolls
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Soften the lasagne sheets in boiling water for 3 minutes.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, egg, nutmeg and salt. Spread on each sheet and roll up.
Spread half the sauce in a dish, add the rolls seam side down, cover with the rest of the sauce and the mozzarella.
Bake for 30 minutes until bubbling.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Tacos with Chipotle Sauce
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the cauliflower with the oil, spices and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle and a squeeze of lime.
Fill warm tortillas with cauliflower and cabbage and drizzle with the sauce.

recipes.title: Vegan Chili Sin Carne
steps: Cook the onion and peppers in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, TVP and stock and simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.

recipes.title: Tempeh Tacos
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the tempeh and cook 5 minutes until browned.
Stir in the taco seasoning, tomato paste and 120 ml water and simmer 3 minutes.
Fill the taco shells with tempeh, lettuce and salsa.

recipes.title: Ratatouille Sheet Pan
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).
Toss everything except the basil with salt and pepper on a large tray.
Roast for 35-40 minutes, stirring halfway, until soft and browned. Scatter with basil.

recipes.title: Spanakopita Pie
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the spinach until wilted. Cool, squeeze out the liquid and chop.
Mix with the feta, eggs and dill.
Layer 5 phyllo sheets in a buttered dish, brushing each with butter. Spread in the filling and top with the rest of the sheets, buttering each.
Score the top and bake at 180°C (160°C fan) for 40 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Feta and Chickpeas
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.
Make hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6-8 minutes until the whites are set. Top with feta.

recipes.title: Vegetable Tikka Traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).
Mix the tandoori paste, yogurt, oil and salt and toss with the vegetables and chickpeas.
Spread on a large tray and roast for 30-35 minutes until charred. Squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.title: Pesto Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Remove the mushroom stems and brush the caps with oil.
Spread each cap with pesto, add tomatoes and mozzarella, and top with breadcrumbs.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until the mushrooms are tender and the top is golden.

recipes.title: Vegan Pad Kra Pao with Tofu
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes until golden in places.
Add the garlic, chilies and onion and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and sugar and toss, then stir in the basil until wilted. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Peanut Stew
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the sweet potatoes, tomatoes, peanut butter and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and kale and simmer 8 minutes until the kale is tender.

recipes.title: Halloumi Fajitas
steps: Cook the peppers and onion in the oil with the seasoning over high heat for 6 minutes. Set aside.
Fry the halloumi in the same pan for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Fill the tortillas with vegetables, halloumi and avocado and squeeze over lime.

recipes.title: Zucchini Fritters
steps: Toss the zucchini with the salt, leave 10 minutes, then squeeze out as much water as you can.
Mix with the eggs, flour, feta, green onions and dill.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden. Serve with yogurt.

recipes.title: Bean and Vegetable Cassoulet
steps: Soften the vegetables in 2 tablespoons oil for 10 minutes, add the garlic and thyme.
Add the beans, tomatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Pour into a baking dish, top with the breadcrumbs mixed with the rest of the oil and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Baked Potatoes
steps: Bake the potatoes at 200°C (180°C fan) for about 1 hour until soft.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Stir in the cheese.
Split the potatoes and top with broccoli and cheese sauce.

recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Fry the onions in the ghee for 12 minutes until deep golden; set half aside.
Add the paste and garam masala, then the vegetables and yogurt and cook 8 minutes.
Parboil the rice for 5 minutes, drain and layer over the vegetables. Top with mint and fried onions.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Tofu Katsu with Cabbage Salad
steps: Pat the tofu dry. Dip in flour, then soy milk, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Toss the cabbage with the vinegar and a pinch of salt. Mix the ketchup and Worcestershire sauce for a quick katsu sauce. Note that some Worcestershire sauces contain anchovy.

recipes.title: Moroccan Lentil Stew
steps: Soften the onion and carrots in the oil for 6 minutes and stir in the ras el hanout.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock and simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Pasta Fagioli
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic and seasoning.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and simmer 10 minutes until tender, adding water if it gets too thick.

recipes.title: Quinoa Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
steps: Cook the quinoa in 300 ml water for 15 minutes.
Mix with the beans, corn, salsa, cumin and salt and fill the peppers.
Top with cheese, cover with foil and bake at 190°C (170°C fan) for 25 minutes, then uncover for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Coconut Lentil Curry
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the paste and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, coconut milk, tomatoes and water and simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Stir in the spinach and season.

recipes.title: Gado Gado
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes. Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden.
Whisk the peanut butter, kecap manis, sambal, lime juice and warm water into a pourable sauce.
Arrange the potatoes, beans, halved eggs, tofu, cucumber and sprouts on a platter and pour over the sauce.

recipes.title: Mushroom Fajita Bowls
steps: Cook the mushrooms, peppers and onion in the oil with the seasoning over high heat for 10 minutes.
Warm the beans.
Build bowls with rice, beans, vegetables and avocado and add a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Split Pea Soup with Ham
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the butter for 6 minutes.
Add the split peas, stock and bay leaves, bring to a boil and simmer, partly covered, for 60-70 minutes, stirring now and then, until the peas break down.
Stir in the ham and simmer 5 minutes. Remove the bay leaves and season.

recipes.title: Carrot Ginger Soup
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the ginger for 1 minute.
Add the carrots and stock and simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the coconut milk and season.

recipes.title: Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato Soup
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and paprika.
Add the peppers, tomatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Soften the onion in the butter for 5 minutes, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and milk.
Add the broccoli and carrot and simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Blend about half the soup, then stir in the cheese off the heat until melted.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Soup
steps: Cook the onion and mushrooms in the butter for 10 minutes until browned. Add the garlic and thyme.
Stir in the flour, then gradually add the stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend half the soup, stir back in with the cream and season.

recipes.title: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup
steps: Simmer the coconut milk and stock with the lemongrass and ginger for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and mushrooms and simmer 6 minutes until cooked.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice, remove the lemongrass and ginger, and top with chili and cilantro.

recipes.title: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer with the mushrooms, tofu and bamboo shoots for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar and pepper. Mix the cornstarch with 4 tablespoons water and stir in until slightly thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the egg while stirring to make ribbons. Top with green onions.

recipes.title: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the ginger and soy sauce for 5 minutes.
Thicken with the cornstarch mixed with a little water.
Stir the soup in a circle and slowly pour in the eggs to form ribbons. Finish with green onions and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Wonton Soup
steps: Mix the pork, soy sauce, ginger and green onions.
Put a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edges, fold into triangles and press to seal.
Bring the stock to a simmer, add the wontons and cook 4 minutes, then the bok choy for 1 minute. Finish with sesame oil.

recipes.title: Tom Yum Shrimp Soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the lemongrass and ginger for 10 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and tomatoes for 2 minutes, then the shrimp for 3 minutes.
Stir in the fish sauce, lime juice and chili garlic sauce, and top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Italian Wedding Soup
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, parmesan and egg and roll into small balls.
Soften the onion and carrots in the oil, add the stock and bring to a simmer.
Drop in the meatballs and orzo and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the spinach.

recipes.title: Ribollita
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil for 10 minutes, add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, beans, kale and stock and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the bread and simmer 5 minutes until the soup is thick. Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.title: Gazpacho
steps: Blend everything with 1 teaspoon salt until very smooth.
Chill for at least 1 hour and adjust the salt and vinegar before serving.

recipes.title: Spiced Red Lentil and Tomato Soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil, add the tomato paste and spices for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer 25 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Beef and Barley Soup
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches.
Soften the vegetables, then add the beef, barley, stock, tomatoes and thyme.
Simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours until the beef and barley are tender.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, then soften the onion in the fat. Stir in the flour.
Add the potatoes, corn and stock and simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the milk, blend a little of the soup for body and top with green onions.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder
steps: Fry the bacon, then soften the onion and celery in the fat for 5 minutes. Stir in the flour.
Add the potatoes, clam juice, thyme and 300 ml water and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the milk, cream and clams and heat gently for 5 minutes without boiling.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortellini Soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrots in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the stock and seasoning and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the tortellini and chicken and cook 4 minutes, then the spinach.

recipes.title: Vegetable Barley Soup
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the barley, tomatoes, stock and thyme and simmer 35 minutes.
Add the beans and simmer 8 minutes more.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Coconut Soup
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil, then stir in the curry powder.
Add the sweet potatoes and stock and simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Blend with the coconut milk and add lime juice to taste.

recipes.title: Pozole Rojo
steps: Simmer the pork with the onion, garlic and 1 tablespoon salt in 2.5 liters of water for 1.5 hours.
Soak the chilies in hot water for 15 minutes, then blend with a ladle of broth and strain into the pot.
Add the hominy and oregano and simmer 30 minutes more.
Serve with cabbage, radishes and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Harira-Style Chickpea Soup
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the oil and add the spices.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, chickpeas and stock and simmer 35 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Irish Beef and Stout-Style Stew
steps: Toss the beef in flour and brown in the oil in batches.
Soften the onions, add the tomato paste, then the beer, stock and thyme and return the beef.
Cover and simmer for 1.5 hours, add the carrots and potatoes and cook 45 minutes more until tender.

recipes.title: Beef Pho-Style Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer the stock with the onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon for 30 minutes. Strain and add the fish sauce.
Cook the noodles and divide between bowls. Lay the raw steak on top.
Pour the boiling broth over to cook the beef. Serve with sprouts, basil and lime.

recipes.title: Kimchi Jjigae
steps: Fry the pork belly in a pot until it renders, then add the kimchi and fry 5 minutes.
Add the gochujang, chili flakes and water and simmer 15 minutes.
Slide in the tofu and simmer 5 minutes. Top with green onions and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Miso Soup with Tofu
steps: Heat the dashi until just simmering.
Whisk the miso with a ladle of dashi and stir it back in. Do not boil after adding the miso.
Add the tofu to warm through and top with green onions and nori.

recipes.title: Avgolemono Soup
steps: Simmer the rice in the stock for 15 minutes, then add the chicken.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice. Slowly whisk in two ladles of hot stock.
Pour the egg mix back into the pot off the heat, stirring, until silky. Do not boil. Add dill.

recipes.title: Waldorf Salad
steps: Toss the apples with the lemon juice.
Mix in the celery, grapes and walnuts, then the mayonnaise and yogurt.
Serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
steps: Arrange the lettuce on a platter.
Lay the chicken, bacon, chopped eggs, tomatoes, avocado and blue cheese in rows on top.
Drizzle with dressing at the table.

recipes.title: Fattoush
steps: Toss the pita with 1 tablespoon oil and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 8 minutes until crisp.
Mix the vegetables and herbs.
Whisk the lemon juice, the rest of the oil, sumac and salt, and toss with the salad and crisp pita.

recipes.title: Panzanella
steps: Toss the bread with 2 tablespoons oil and toast at 200°C (180°C fan) for 10 minutes.
Mix the tomatoes with a good pinch of salt and leave 10 minutes to release their juice.
Toss everything with the vinegar and the rest of the oil and leave 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Kale Caesar Salad
steps: Massage the kale with a pinch of salt for 1 minute until it softens.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, anchovies and half the parmesan.
Toss with the kale and top with croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.title: Black Bean and Corn Salad
steps: Mix the beans, corn, pepper, onion and tomatoes.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin and salt, and toss with the salad and cilantro.

recipes.title: Asian Chicken Salad
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and honey.
Toss the cabbage, carrots, green onions and chicken with the dressing.
Top with cashews.

recipes.title: Three Bean Salad
steps: Whisk the vinegar, oil, sugar and 1 teaspoon salt.
Toss with the beans and onion and chill for at least 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Classic Coleslaw
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard and a pinch of salt.
Toss with the cabbage and carrots and chill for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pasta Salad with Italian Dressing
steps: Cook the pasta, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, seasoning and salt.
Toss everything together and chill until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Watermelon Feta Salad
steps: Arrange the watermelon on a platter with the onion.
Scatter over the feta and mint, then drizzle with lime juice and olive oil.

recipes.title: Lentil Salad with Feta
steps: Simmer the lentils for 18-20 minutes until tender but holding their shape. Drain.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt and toss with the warm lentils.
Fold in the onion, tomatoes and parsley and top with feta.

recipes.title: Thai Beef Salad
steps: Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side, rest and slice thinly.
Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and chili.
Toss the steak with the vegetables, herbs and dressing.

recipes.title: Chickpea Tuna-Style Salad Sandwiches
steps: Mash the chickpeas roughly with a fork.
Mix in the mayonnaise, mustard, celery, pickles, lemon juice and salt. Use vegan mayonnaise to make it vegan.
Spread on bread with lettuce.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Salad Bowls
steps: Rub the chicken with 1 tablespoon oil, oregano, salt and half the lemon juice. Pan-fry 6 minutes per side, rest and slice.
Toss the vegetables and olives with the rest of the oil and lemon.
Build bowls with salad, chicken, feta and a spoon of hummus.

recipes.title: Beet and Goat Cheese Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, honey and salt.
Arrange the arugula and beets on plates, scatter with goat cheese and walnuts and drizzle with dressing.

recipes.title: Classic BLT
steps: Fry or bake the bacon until crisp.
Spread the toast with mayonnaise and layer with lettuce, tomato and bacon. Season the tomato with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Cuban-Style Pressed Sandwiches
steps: Spread the rolls with mustard and layer with ham, pork, cheese and pickles.
Butter the outsides and press in a hot pan under a heavy pan for 3-4 minutes per side until crisp and melted.

recipes.title: Philly-Style Cheesesteaks
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in half the oil for 8 minutes. Set aside.
Sear the steak in the rest of the oil over high heat for 2-3 minutes, season and mix with the vegetables.
Divide into four piles, top with cheese to melt, then scoop into the rolls.

recipes.title: Banh Mi-Style Sandwiches
steps: Toss the carrots and daikon with the vinegar, a teaspoon of sugar and a pinch of salt. Leave 15 minutes.
Fry the pork with the garlic, fish sauce and the rest of the sugar until browned.
Spread the bread with mayonnaise and fill with pork, pickled vegetables, cucumber and cilantro.

recipes.title: Caprese Panini
steps: Spread the bread with pesto and fill with mozzarella and tomato.
Brush the outsides with oil and press in a hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Sandwiches
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard, chives, salt and pepper.
Spread on bread with lettuce.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Croissants
steps: Mix the chicken, mayonnaise, celery, grapes and pecans with salt and pepper.
Fill the croissants.

recipes.title: Grilled Veggie and Hummus Wraps
steps: Brush the vegetables with oil and grill in a hot pan for 2-3 minutes per side.
Spread the tortillas with hummus, add the vegetables and arugula, and roll up.

recipes.title: Reuben-Style Sandwiches
steps: Mix the mayonnaise and ketchup.
Layer the bread with sauce, beef, sauerkraut and cheese.
Butter the outsides and toast in a pan for 3-4 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Falafel Pita Pockets
steps: Prepare the falafel mix following the packet, shape into balls and fry in the oil until crisp.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and water to a sauce.
Stuff the pita with falafel, tomato and cucumber and drizzle with sauce.

recipes.title: Tofu Banh Mi
steps: Toss the carrots with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden, then add the soy sauce and toss.
Fill the bread with tofu, pickled carrots, cucumber, jalapeno and cilantro.

recipes.title: Meatball Subs
steps: Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, seasoning and salt and roll into 16 balls.
Brown in a pan, add the marinara and simmer 15 minutes.
Fill the rolls, top with mozzarella and grill until melted.

recipes.title: Pan Bagnat-Style Tuna Sandwiches
steps: Split the bread and drizzle with the oil and vinegar.
Fill with tuna, eggs, tomatoes, olives and onion.
Wrap tightly and press under a weight for 15 minutes so the flavors soak in.

recipes.title: Smashed Chickpea Avocado Toast
steps: Mash the chickpeas and avocado with the lemon juice and salt.
Spread on toast and sprinkle with chili flakes.

recipes.title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Balsamic
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the sprouts with the oil and salt, cut side down on a tray.
Roast for 20-25 minutes until crisp and browned.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and sprinkle with parmesan.

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Air Fryer Fries
steps: Soak the fries in cold water for 15 minutes, then dry well.
Toss with the oil, garlic powder and salt and air fry at 200°C for 18-20 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes.
Toss with the parmesan and parsley.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Wedges
steps: Toss the wedges with the oil, paprika and salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 16-18 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp outside and soft inside.

recipes.title: Elote-Style Corn
steps: Grill or broil the corn until charred in spots, about 10 minutes, turning.
Brush with mayonnaise, roll in cotija and sprinkle with chili powder and cilantro. Serve with lime.

recipes.title: Sauteed Spinach with Garlic
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic until it sizzles.
Add the spinach in handfuls, tossing until wilted. Season and squeeze over the lemon.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower with Tahini
steps: Toss the cauliflower with the oil, cumin and salt and roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 25 minutes.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and water.
Drizzle over the cauliflower and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Southern Collard Greens
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, then soften the onion and garlic in the fat.
Add the greens, stock and chili and simmer, covered, for 45-60 minutes until tender.
Stir in the vinegar and season.

recipes.title: Cornbread
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and grease a 20 cm square tin.
Mix the dry ingredients, then stir in the eggs, buttermilk and butter until just combined.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Mac and Cheese Bites
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and grease a mini muffin tin.
Mix everything with a pinch of salt and spoon into the tin.
Bake for 15 minutes until set and golden. Cool 5 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Refried Beans

ingredients.name: Pinto beans, with a little liquid

steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and cumin.
Add the beans and mash them in the pan, adding liquid until creamy. Season.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Snow Peas and Mushrooms
steps: Stir-fry the mushrooms in the oil over high heat for 2 minutes.
Add the snow peas and garlic for 2 minutes, then the oyster sauce and a splash of water.

recipes.title: Smashed Cucumber Salad
steps: Smash the cucumbers with a rolling pin, cut into chunks and toss with a pinch of salt. Drain for 10 minutes.
Mix with the garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar and chili oil.

recipes.title: Scalloped Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and butter a baking dish.
Warm the cream, milk, garlic, nutmeg and 1.5 teaspoons salt.
Layer the potatoes in the dish, pour over the cream and top with the cheese.
Bake for 70-75 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden.

recipes.title: Roasted Root Vegetables
steps: Toss everything except the honey with salt on a large tray.
Roast at 210°C (190°C fan) for 35 minutes, drizzle with honey and roast 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Saag Aloo
steps: Boil the potatoes for 8 minutes and drain.
Fry the cumin seeds in the oil, then the onion for 5 minutes and the paste and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and fry 5 minutes, then the spinach until wilted. Stir in the garam masala.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Blanch the beans for 4 minutes and drain.
Mix the soup, milk and soy sauce, fold in the beans and spread in a dish.
Bake 25 minutes, top with the crispy onions and bake 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Tostones
steps: Peel the plantains and cut into 3 cm pieces. Fry in hot oil for 3 minutes until light gold.
Smash each piece flat with the bottom of a glass.
Fry again for 2 minutes until crisp. Drain, salt and toss with garlic.

recipes.title: Couscous with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Roast the vegetables with the oil and cumin at 220°C (200°C fan) for 25 minutes.
Pour the stock over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff.
Fold in the vegetables and mint.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Sweet Potatoes
steps: Toss everything together on a lined tray.
Roast at 210°C (190°C fan) for 30 minutes, turning once, until caramelized.

recipes.title: Glazed Air Fryer Carrots
steps: Toss the carrots with the oil, thyme and salt.
Air fry at 190°C for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway. Toss with the maple syrup.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Asparagus
steps: Toss the asparagus with the oil, garlic and salt.
Roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 10-12 minutes. Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.title: Braised Red Cabbage
steps: Soften the onion in the butter for 5 minutes.
Add everything else with 150 ml water and 1 teaspoon salt.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and glossy.

recipes.title: Herb Roasted Mushrooms
steps: Toss the mushrooms with the oil, garlic, thyme and salt.
Roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 20 minutes until browned. Toss with parsley.

recipes.title: Cumin Roasted Carrots with Yogurt
steps: Toss the carrots with the oil, cumin and salt and roast at 210°C (190°C fan) for 25-30 minutes.
Drizzle with honey, spoon over yogurt and scatter with mint.

recipes.title: Spicy Garlic Edamame
steps: Boil the edamame for 4 minutes and drain.
Warm the oil with the garlic and chili, add the edamame and soy sauce and toss.

recipes.title: Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together, then whisk in the sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, cocoa and salt.
Bake for 22-25 minutes until just set with a slightly gooey center. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Rub the flour, powdered sugar and butter together, press into a lined 20 x 30 cm tin and bake 18 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, lemon zest and juice and cornstarch.
Pour over the hot base and bake 20 minutes until set. Cool completely and dust with more powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and sugar until creamy, then the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, oats and raisins.
Drop spoonfuls onto the trays and bake for 10-12 minutes until golden at the edges.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan).
Mix everything until smooth, roll into 20 balls and flatten with a fork in a crisscross.
Bake for 9-10 minutes. Let them firm up on the tray before moving.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan).
Beat the butter with 150 g sugar, then the egg. Stir in the flour, cream of tartar and baking soda.
Roll into balls and coat in the rest of the sugar mixed with the cinnamon.
Bake for 9-10 minutes until puffed and crackled.

recipes.title: Shortbread
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan).
Beat the butter and sugar, then work in the flour and salt to a dough.
Press into a 20 cm square tin, prick all over and bake 25 minutes until pale golden. Cut while warm.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 23 x 33 cm tin.
Whisk the eggs, sugar and oil, then fold in the flour, baking powder, soda, cinnamon, carrots and walnuts.
Bake for 35-40 minutes and cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar into a frosting and spread over the cake.

recipes.title: Vegan Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 20 cm square tin.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the water, oil, vinegar and vanilla until smooth.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Lemon Drizzle Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a loaf tin.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour and lemon zest.
Bake for 45 minutes until risen.
Mix the lemon juice with the powdered sugar and pour over the warm cake after poking it all over with a skewer.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (155°C fan) and line a loaf tin.
Whisk the pumpkin, eggs, sugar and oil, then fold in the dry ingredients.
Bake for 55-60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (155°C fan) and line a loaf tin.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla, then fold in the zucchini and dry ingredients.
Bake for 50-55 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls

ingredients.name: Butter, half melted for the dough, half softened for the filling

steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, a pinch of salt, milk, egg and the melted half of the butter and knead for 8 minutes. Leave to rise for 1 hour.
Roll out to 30 x 45 cm, spread with the softened butter and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up and cut into 12.
Arrange in a lined tin, rise 30 minutes, then bake at 180°C (160°C fan) for 22-25 minutes.
Mix the powdered sugar with 2 tablespoons water and drizzle over.

recipes.title: No-Knead Bread
steps: Mix everything into a shaggy dough, cover and leave at room temperature for 12-18 hours.
Shape into a ball on a floured surface and rest 1 hour.
Bake in a preheated covered pot at 230°C (210°C fan) for 30 minutes, then uncovered for 15 minutes until deep brown.

recipes.title: Easy Pizza Dough Margherita
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, water and oil and knead 5 minutes. Rest 1 hour.
Heat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside. Divide the dough in two and stretch thin.
Spread with sauce, add mozzarella and bake on the hot tray for 10-12 minutes. Top with basil.

recipes.title: Focaccia
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and water into a sticky dough. Cover and leave for 1.5 hours.
Pour 3 tablespoons oil into a 23 x 33 cm tin, add the dough and stretch it out. Rest 30 minutes.
Dimple with oiled fingers, drizzle with the rest of the oil, sprinkle with rosemary and flaky salt.
Bake at 220°C (200°C fan) for 22-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Naan
steps: Mix everything except the butter into a soft dough, knead 5 minutes and rest 1 hour.
Divide into 8 and roll into ovals.
Cook in a very hot dry pan for 1-2 minutes per side until puffed and charred. Brush with butter.

recipes.title: Flour Tortillas
steps: Mix everything into a soft dough and knead 2 minutes. Rest 20 minutes.
Divide into 8 and roll each very thin.
Cook in a hot dry pan for 30-45 seconds per side until bubbly and spotted.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line a pie dish with one crust.
Toss the apples with the sugar, flour, cinnamon and lemon juice and pile into the dish. Dot with butter.
Cover with the second crust, seal, cut vents and brush with egg.
Bake for 45-50 minutes until golden and bubbling. Cool for at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Toss the peaches with 100 g sugar and the cinnamon.
Pour the butter into a baking dish. Mix the flour, baking powder, the other 100 g sugar and milk, and pour over the butter without stirring.
Spoon the peaches on top and bake for 40 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Berry Crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Toss the berries with the sugar and cornstarch in a dish.
Rub the flour, oats, brown sugar and butter into crumbs and scatter over.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Tiramisu
steps: Beat the yolks with the sugar until pale, then beat in the mascarpone.
Whisk the whites to soft peaks and fold in.
Dip the ladyfingers quickly in coffee and layer in a dish with the cream, twice.
Chill at least 4 hours and dust with cocoa. Contains raw egg.

recipes.title: Panna Cotta with Berries
steps: Sprinkle the gelatin over 3 tablespoons cold milk and leave 5 minutes.
Heat the cream, remaining milk and sugar until steaming, take off the heat and stir in the gelatin until dissolved. Add the vanilla.
Pour into 6 glasses and chill for at least 4 hours. Top with raspberries.

recipes.title: Creme Brulee

ingredients.name: Sugar, 80 g for the custard and the rest for the tops

steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Warm the cream with the vanilla.
Whisk the yolks with 80 g sugar, then whisk in the cream and strain into 6 ramekins.
Bake in a water bath for 35-40 minutes until just set with a wobble. Chill.
Sprinkle each with a teaspoon of sugar and caramelize with a torch or under a very hot grill.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding
steps: Whisk the sugar, cocoa and cornstarch, then whisk in the milk.
Cook over medium heat, whisking, until thick and bubbling, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the chocolate and vanilla, pour into bowls and chill.

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Steam the rice for 20-25 minutes until tender.
Warm 300 ml coconut milk with the sugar and salt and stir into the hot rice. Leave 15 minutes to absorb.
Serve with mango, the rest of the coconut milk spooned over, and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Churros

ingredients.name: Sugar, 2 tbsp for the dough and the rest for coating

steps: Boil the water, 2 tablespoons of the sugar, the butter and a pinch of salt, then beat in the flour until it forms a ball. Cool 5 minutes and beat in the eggs.
Pipe 10 cm lengths into oil heated to 180°C and fry 2-3 minutes until golden.
Roll in the cinnamon sugar.

recipes.title: Banana Nice Cream
steps: Blend the frozen banana with the milk, scraping down often, until it looks like soft-serve.
Swirl in the peanut butter and eat at once, or freeze for 1 hour for a firmer scoop.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C (190°C fan). Rub the butter into the flour, baking powder and 2 tablespoons sugar, then stir in the cream.
Pat out and cut 6 rounds. Bake 12-15 minutes.
Toss the strawberries with the rest of the sugar. Split the shortcakes and fill with strawberries and whipped cream.

recipes.title: Rice Krispie-Style Marshmallow Treats
steps: Melt the butter in a large pan, add the marshmallows and stir until melted.
Stir in the cereal and press into a greased 20 x 30 cm tin. Cool and cut.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cheesecake
steps: Mix the crumbs and butter and press into a 23 cm springform tin.
Beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar and lemon juice until smooth.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in. Spread over the base and chill at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroons
steps: Heat the oven to 165°C (145°C fan). Mix the coconut, condensed milk and vanilla.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks with a pinch of salt and fold in.
Scoop onto a lined tray and bake 18-20 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Baklava
steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (155°C fan). Mix the nuts with the cinnamon.
Layer 8 sheets of phyllo in a 23 x 33 cm tin, brushing each with butter. Scatter with half the nuts, add 4 sheets, the rest of the nuts, and finish with the remaining sheets, brushing each.
Cut into diamonds and bake for 45 minutes.
Boil the sugar with 200 ml water, the honey and a squeeze of lemon for 8 minutes and pour over the hot baklava. Cool completely.

recipes.title: Gulab Jamun-Style Milk Dumplings
steps: Boil the sugar with 400 ml water and the cardamom for 5 minutes.
Mix the milk powder, flour and soda, rub in the ghee and add milk to make a soft dough. Roll into 18 smooth balls.
Fry over low heat, turning, for 6-8 minutes until deep brown. Drop into the warm syrup and soak 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Tres Leches Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Whisk the eggs and sugar until thick and pale, then fold in the flour and baking powder.
Bake in a lined 23 x 33 cm tin for 25-30 minutes.
Poke holes all over and pour over the three milks mixed together. Chill overnight and top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Bark with Nuts
steps: Melt the chocolate and spread thinly on a lined tray.
Scatter over the nuts, cranberries and seeds and chill until set. Break into pieces.

recipes.title: Vanilla Sheet Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 23 x 33 cm tin.
Beat 170 g butter with the sugar, then the eggs, then fold in the flour and baking powder alternately with the milk and vanilla.
Bake for 28-30 minutes and cool.
Beat the frosting butter with the powdered sugar and a splash of milk and spread over.

recipes.title: Pecan Pie Bars

ingredients.name: Butter, 100 g cold and 50 g melted

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Rub the flour, cold butter and sugar together, press into a lined 20 x 30 cm tin and bake 15 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, brown sugar, maple syrup and melted butter and stir in the pecans.
Pour over the base and bake 25 minutes until set. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Bread and Butter Pudding
steps: Cut the bread into triangles and layer in a buttered dish with the raisins.
Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar and vanilla and pour over. Rest 15 minutes and grate over nutmeg.
Bake at 180°C (160°C fan) for 35-40 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.title: Poached Pears in Red Wine
steps: Bring the wine, sugar, spices and orange peel to a simmer.
Add the pears, cover and poach gently for 25-30 minutes, turning, until tender.
Lift out the pears and boil the liquid until syrupy. Serve the pears with the syrup.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Cinnamon Apple Chips
steps: Toss the apple slices with the cinnamon and sugar.
Air fry in a single layer at 150°C for 15-20 minutes, turning halfway, until dry. They crisp as they cool.

recipes.title: Vegan Oat Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan).
Mix everything into a dough and roll into 16 balls. Flatten on a lined tray.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until golden. Check the chocolate is dairy-free if needed.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush
steps: Prick the eggplants and roast at 220°C (200°C fan), or char over a flame, for 35-40 minutes until collapsed.
Scoop out the flesh, drain for 10 minutes and mash with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt.
Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Tzatziki
steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber dry in a towel.
Mix with the yogurt, garlic, oil, dill, lemon juice and salt. Chill 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pico de Gallo
steps: Mix everything with half a teaspoon of salt and leave 10 minutes before serving.
Taste and add more lime or salt. It is best the day it is made.

recipes.title: Restaurant-Style Blender Salsa
steps: Pulse everything with 1 teaspoon salt in a blender until finely chopped but not completely smooth.
Chill for 30 minutes to let the flavors come together.

recipes.title: Basil Pesto
steps: Blend the basil, pine nuts and garlic with a pinch of salt.
Add the parmesan and drizzle in the oil until you have a loose paste.

recipes.title: Quick Marinara Sauce
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic until pale gold, then add the chili and oregano.
Add the tomatoes, crushing them, with 1 teaspoon salt and simmer 20 minutes. Tear in the basil.

recipes.title: Classic Bechamel
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes until thick. Season with salt and nutmeg.

recipes.title: Easy Cheese Sauce
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk and simmer until thick, then stir in the cheese and mustard off the heat.

recipes.title: Peanut Sauce
steps: Whisk everything together with 4-6 tablespoons of hot water until smooth and pourable.
Taste and adjust with more lime, soy sauce or sriracha. Keeps 5 days in the fridge; loosen with water before using.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Sauce from Scratch
steps: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger for 2 minutes.
Thicken with the cornstarch mixed with a tablespoon of water.

recipes.title: Homemade BBQ Sauce
steps: Simmer everything together for 15 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy. Cool and refrigerate.
Store in a clean jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Garlic Yogurt Sauce
steps: Mix everything with a pinch of salt.
Rest for 10 minutes so the garlic mellows, then serve with grilled meat, falafel or roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Tahini Sauce
steps: Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, garlic and salt. It will seize at first.
Whisk in cold water a little at a time until smooth and pourable.

recipes.title: Classic Vinaigrette
steps: Shake everything in a jar with salt and pepper until emulsified. Keeps a week in the fridge.
Shake again just before using, as it separates on standing.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Sauce
steps: Mix everything with half a teaspoon of salt and rest 15 minutes.
Serve with grilled steak, chicken or vegetables. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Mint Cilantro Chutney
steps: Blend everything with a pinch of salt and 3 tablespoons water until smooth.
Taste and adjust the salt and lemon. Keeps 3 days in a covered jar in the fridge.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Dip
steps: Stir everything together until smooth.
Serve with chicken tenders, pretzels or as a sandwich spread.

recipes.title: Simple Gravy
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook until light brown, about 3 minutes.
Whisk in the stock and Worcestershire sauce and simmer until thick.

recipes.title: Sriracha Mayo
steps: Stir together. Great on burgers, rice bowls and fries.
Taste and add more sriracha for extra heat. Keeps a week in the fridge.

recipes.title: Ranch Dressing from Scratch
steps: Whisk everything with salt and pepper and chill 30 minutes.
Thin with a little more buttermilk for a salad dressing, or keep it thick as a dip.

recipes.title: Caramelized Onion Dip
steps: Cook the onions in the butter over low heat for 30-35 minutes until deep brown. Cool and chop.
Mix with the sour cream, cream cheese, garlic powder and salt.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Spinach Artichoke Dip
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan).
Mix everything except the chips and spread in a small dish.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbling. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Seven Layer Dip

ingredients.name: Avocados, mashed with a pinch of salt

steps: Mix the beans with the taco seasoning and spread in a dish.
Layer the sour cream, avocado, salsa, cheese, tomatoes and green onions.
Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Popcorn with Parmesan and Herbs
steps: Heat the oil with the kernels in a large covered pot over medium-high heat, shaking, until popping slows.
Toss with the butter, parmesan, seasoning and salt.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chickpeas
steps: Toss the chickpeas with the oil and spices.
Air fry at 190°C for 12-15 minutes, shaking every 5 minutes, until crisp.

recipes.title: Stuffed Mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Cook the chopped stems with the garlic in the oil for 4 minutes.
Mix with the cream cheese and parmesan and fill the caps.
Top with breadcrumbs and bake 18-20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pigs in Blankets
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Wrap each sausage in half a slice of bacon.
Bake for 20 minutes until crisp, brushing with honey for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Caprese Skewers
steps: Thread a tomato, basil leaf and mozzarella ball onto each toothpick.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic glaze and season.

recipes.title: Cheese Quesadilla Triangles for Kids
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with cheese and fold.
Toast in the butter for 2-3 minutes per side and cut into triangles.

recipes.title: Energy Balls
steps: Blend the dates until sticky, then add the rest and pulse into a dough. Add a splash of water if dry.
Roll into 16 balls and chill.

recipes.title: Hummus with Spiced Lamb
steps: Fry the lamb in the oil with the baharat and salt until crisp, adding the pine nuts for the last 2 minutes.
Spread the hummus on a plate and spoon over the lamb. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with pita.
